title: Adjectival complement "de budeliao"
structure: Adj. + 得不得了
explanation: “得不得了”作程度补语，表示程度极高，可褒可贬。注意不要与“不得不”混淆。

examples.zh: 爸爸气得不得了，你要倒霉啦。
examples.pinyin: Bàba qì de bùdéliǎo, nǐ yào dǎoméi la.
examples.en: Dad is super angry. You're in for it.

examples.zh: 她的妈妈刚去世，她难过得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de māma gāng qùshì, tā nánguò de bùdéliǎo.
examples.en: Her mom just passed away, so she is extremely upset.

examples.zh: 今天冷得不得了，怎么会这么冷？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lěng de bùdéliǎo, zěnme huì zhème lěng?
examples.en: It's terribly cold today! How can it be this cold?

examples.zh: 这件衣服，我喜欢得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu, wǒ xǐhuan de bùdéliǎo.
examples.en: I absolutely love these clothes.

title: Adjectival complement "de hen"
structure: Adj. + 得很
explanation: “得很”作程度补语，表示程度高，比“很 + 形容词”更口语、强调更强。

examples.zh: 我好得很，你不用为我担心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo de hěn, nǐ bùyòng wèi wǒ dānxīn.
examples.en: I'm doing great. You don't need to worry about me.

examples.zh: 这个地方漂亮得很，非常推荐你去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang piàoliang de hěn, fēicháng tuījiàn nǐ qù.
examples.en: This place is gorgeous. I strongly recommend you visit.

examples.zh: 不用担心，这次考试简单得很。
examples.pinyin: Bùyòng dānxīn, zhè cì kǎoshì jiǎndān de hěn.
examples.en: Don't worry. This test is super simple.

examples.zh: 他这个人自私得很，从来不为别人考虑。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège rén zìsī de hěn, cónglái bù wèi biérén kǎolǜ.
examples.en: He's incredibly selfish. He never considers other people.

title: Expressing "a little too" with "Adj. + 了(一)点儿"
structure: Adj. + 了(一)点儿
explanation: “形容词 + 了(一)点儿”表示“稍微……了一点”，语气比“太”委婉。形容词为贬义时常表不满，为褒义时常表变化。

examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤好像短了点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo niúzǎikù hǎoxiàng duǎn le diǎnr.
examples.en: This pair of jeans seems a little short for me.

examples.zh: 这件衬衫小了点儿，我想换一件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chènshān xiǎo le diǎnr, wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn.
examples.en: This shirt is a little small. I want to exchange it for another one.

examples.zh: 这道菜咸了点儿，可以换一盘吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xián le diǎnr, kěyǐ huàn yī pán ma?
examples.en: This dish is a little too salty, could you make another one?

examples.zh: 对五岁的孩子来说，这个问题稍微复杂了一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǔ suì de háizi lái shuō, zhège wèntí shāowēi fùzá le yīdiǎnr.
examples.en: This question is just a bit complicated for a five-year-old child.

title: Saying "a lot" with "youdeshi"
structure: Subj. + 有的是 + Noun；Noun + Subj. + 有的是
explanation: “有的是”表示数量很多，有时带夸张语气。注意不是“有的 + 是”。不能直接否定，否定用“没有很多”。

examples.zh: 他爸是大老板，有的是钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bà shì dà lǎobǎn, yǒudeshi qián.
examples.en: His dad is a big boss. He's got plenty of money.

examples.zh: 她是全职妈妈，有的是时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì quánzhí māma, yǒudeshi shíjiān.
examples.en: She's a full-time mother. She's got plenty of time.

examples.zh: 上海这么大的城市，工作机会有的是。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi zhème dà de chéngshì, gōngzuò jīhuì yǒudeshi.
examples.en: Shanghai is such a big city. It's got plenty of job opportunities.

examples.zh: 这样的资源网上有的是。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de zīyuán wǎngshang yǒudeshi.
examples.en: There's a lot of these kinds of resources on the Internet.

title: Advanced uses of "dou"
structure: Subj. + 都 + Predicate；Verb + 都 + Verb + 了，……；都 + 怨/是/怪 + Somebody
explanation: “都”除“全部”外，还可表示“甚至到……程度”、“既然……就……”、“抱怨/责怪”。

examples.zh: 我很想妈妈，有时候我都能看见她。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng māma, yǒu shíhou wǒ dōu néng kànjiàn tā.
examples.en: I really miss Mom. Sometimes I can even see her.

examples.zh: 来都来了，就先别急着走了。
examples.pinyin: Lái dōu lái le, jiù xiān bié jízhe zǒu le.
examples.en: You're here already. No need to be in such a hurry to leave.

examples.zh: 都怪你，出门不带伞。
examples.pinyin: Dōu guài nǐ, chūmén bù dài sǎn.
examples.en: It's all your fault, leaving without bringing an umbrella.

examples.zh: 都是你，害我跑这么远。
examples.pinyin: Dōu shì nǐ, hài wǒ pǎo zhème yuǎn.
examples.en: It's because of you, making me go all that way.

title: Advanced uses of "hai"
structure: Subj. + 还 + Predicate (+ 呢)；Subj. + 还 + Noun Phrase (+ 呢)；Subj. + 还 + [Verb Phrase] + 吗？
explanation: “还”可表示惊讶、不满、讽刺，也可用于反问句。

examples.zh: 这个小孩还真聪明！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎohái hái zhēn cōngming!
examples.en: This kid is brilliant!

examples.zh: 还留过学呢，英语这么差！
examples.pinyin: Hái liú guo xué ne, Yīngyǔ zhème chà!
examples.en: He's even studied abroad, yet his English is so terrible!

examples.zh: 还好朋友呢，天天说我坏话。
examples.pinyin: Hái hǎo péngyou ne, tiāntiān shuō wǒ huàihuà.
examples.en: What a "good friend"! Talking trash about me every day.

examples.zh: 他那么有钱，还在乎这点钱吗？
examples.pinyin: Tā nàme yǒu qián, hái zàihu zhè diǎn qián ma?
examples.en: He has so much money, would he really care about this small amount?

title: Advanced uses of "zong"
structure: 总 + 会/得/要/能 + Verb Phrase (+ 吧)；总 + 不/没 + Verb
explanation: “总”表示“总会/总得/总要/总能”，强调事实或必然；与否定词连用常表推测、判断或建议。

examples.zh: 这里是他家，他总会回来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì tā jiā, tā zǒng huì huílái de.
examples.en: This is his home. He will always come back.

examples.zh: 咱们总得想个办法啊。
examples.pinyin: Zánmen zǒng děi xiǎng gè bànfǎ a.
examples.en: We're going to have to come up with some kind of solution.

examples.zh: 你们之间的联系这么少，看起来总不像是一家人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de liánxì zhème shǎo, kàn qǐlái zǒng bù xiàng shì yījiā rén.
examples.en: You talk to each other so little. It seems that you're barely family.

examples.zh: 这么晚了，总不会出了什么事吧？
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, zǒng bù huì chū le shénme shì ba?
examples.en: It's getting late. Do you think something bad might have happened?

title: Assessing situations with "kanlai"
structure: 看来 + Perspective；在 + Person + 看来 + Perspective
explanation: “看来”表示“看来、似乎”，用于表达说话人对情况的判断。注意与“看起来”（外观）区分。

examples.zh: 看来他不来了，都这么晚了。
examples.pinyin: Kànlái tā bù lái le, dōu zhème wǎn le.
examples.en: It seems he's not coming. It's already so late.

examples.zh: 现在看来，事情没那么糟。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài kànlái, shìqing méi nàme zāo.
examples.en: Now it looks like things aren't that bad.

examples.zh: 在我看来，不会花钱的人就不会享受生活。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, bù huì huā qián de rén jiù bù huì xiǎngshòu shēnghuó.
examples.en: The way I see it, people who won't spend money don't enjoy life.

examples.zh: 在老板看来，加班才说明你工作积极。
examples.pinyin: Zài lǎobǎn kànlái, jiābān cái shuōmíng nǐ gōngzuò jījí.
examples.en: The way the boss sees it, only working overtime means you're proactive in your work.

title: Declaring the only option with "zhihao"
structure: (Subj. +) 只好 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “只好”表示“没有别的选择，只能……”，带不情愿语气。

examples.zh: 餐厅都关门了，我们只好去吃KFC。
examples.pinyin: Cāntīng dōu guānmén le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo qù chī KFC.
examples.en: The other restaurants are all closed, so we didn't have a choice but go to KFC to eat.

examples.zh: 我忘了预约，只好去排队。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le yùyuē, zhǐhǎo qù páiduì.
examples.en: I forgot to make an appointment, so I had to wait in line.

examples.zh: 他没有时间去，只好我去。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shíjiān qù, zhǐhǎo wǒ qù.
examples.en: He doesn't have time to go, so I have to go.

examples.zh: 票价太贵了，我只好放弃了。
examples.pinyin: Piàojià tài guì le, wǒ zhǐhǎo fàngqì le.
examples.en: The fare was too expensive, so I gave up.

title: Intensifying with "ke"
structure: 可 + Adj. + 了；可 + Verb Phrase；可 + Verb Phrase + 了
explanation: “可”用于强调，比一般程度副词更强，常带“出乎意料/终于”语气。多用于北方口语。

examples.zh: 这只小狗可淘气了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu kě táoqì le!
examples.en: This puppy is so naughty!

examples.zh: 我姐姐可好了！有什么好吃的都给我留着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie kě hǎo le! Yǒu shénme hǎochī de dōu gěi wǒ liúzhe.
examples.en: My sister is great! Any good food there is she saves some for me.

examples.zh: 你可别喝太多酒。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié hē tài duō jiǔ.
examples.en: Don't drink too much.

examples.zh: 你可来了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě lái le!
examples.en: You're finally here!

title: Expressing "after all" with "bijing"
explanation: “毕竟”表示“毕竟、终究”，用于强调原因或特征。

examples.zh: 别骂他了，他毕竟是孩子。
examples.pinyin: Bié mà tā le, tā bìjìng shì háizi.
examples.en: Stop yelling at him. He's only a kid, after all.

examples.zh: 毕竟是冬天，你还是多穿点吧。
examples.pinyin: Bìjìng shì dōngtiān, nǐ háishì duō chuān diǎn ba.
examples.en: It's winter, after all. You'd better dress more warmly.

examples.zh: 他不知道也很正常，毕竟他不是本地人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào yě hěn zhèngcháng, bìjìng tā bù shì běndì rén.
examples.en: It's not strange that he doesn't know. He's not a local, after all.

examples.zh: 虽然我跟他认识，但毕竟不太熟，还是不要去麻烦人家了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ gēn tā rènshi, dàn bìjìng bù tài shú, háishì bùyào qù máfan rénjia le.
examples.en: Although I know him, we're not close, after all. We'd better not bother him.

title: Expressing a last chance with "zaibu... jiu..."
structure: (Subj. +) 再不……就……（了）
explanation: “再不……就……”表示“如果不马上……就……”，带紧迫感。

examples.zh: 你再不走，我就叫保安了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù zǒu, wǒ jiù jiào bǎofān le.
examples.en: If you don't leave now, I'm going to call security.

examples.zh: 你再不努力，你就会被淘汰。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù nǔlì, nǐ jiù huì bèi táotài.
examples.en: If you don't start working hard, you're going to get eliminated.

examples.zh: 火车快开了，再不检票就来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē kuài kāi le, zài bù jiǎnpiào jiù láibují le.
examples.en: The train is about to leave! If we don't get our tickets checked now, we're not going to make it.

examples.zh: 今年最后一次优惠，再不抢就没了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián zuìhòu yī cì yōuhuì, zài bù qiǎng jiù méi le.
examples.en: It's the final sale of the year. If you don't grab it, it'll be gone!

title: Expressing "almost" using "chadian mei"
structure: Subj. + 差点 + 没 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “差点没……”有两种用法：① 后接希望的结果 → “差点没……”，实际结果发生了；② 后接不希望的结果 → 与“差点”同义。

examples.zh: 我差点儿没想起来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎnr méi xiǎng qǐlái.
examples.en: I almost couldn't recall it. (I did recall it.)

examples.zh: 我差点没赶上火车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎn méi gǎnshàng huǒchē.
examples.en: I almost missed the train. (I didn't miss it.)

examples.zh: 他差点没通过考试。
examples.pinyin: Tā chàdiǎn méi tōngguò kǎoshì.
examples.en: He barely passed the examination.

examples.zh: 我差点儿没和她撞在一起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎnr méi hé tā zhuàng zài yīqǐ.
examples.en: I almost ran into her.

title: Expressing "anyway" with "fanzheng"
structure: [Disregarded Situation]，反正……；反正 + Reason，Decision/Suggestion；Decision/Suggestion，反正 + Reason
explanation: “反正”表示“反正、无论如何”，用于无视前面的情况或强调理由。

examples.zh: 不管他去不去，反正我要去。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn tā qù bu qù, fǎnzhèng wǒ yào qù.
examples.en: Regardless of whether he's going or not, I'm going anyway.

examples.zh: 不管你信不信，反正我信。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ xìn bu xìn, fǎnzhèng wǒ xìn.
examples.en: No matter whether you believe this or not, I believe it anyway.

examples.zh: 反正他们不来了，咱们自己去吧。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng tāmen bù lái le, zánmen zìjǐ qù ba.
examples.en: They are not coming anyway, so let's just go by ourselves.

examples.zh: 我就送给你吧。反正我也不需要。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiù sòng gěi nǐ ba. Fǎnzhèng wǒ yě bù xūyào.
examples.en: I'll just give it to you. I don't need it anyway.

title: Expressing "as much as possible" with "jinliang"
structure: 尽量 + Verb/Adj.
explanation: “尽量”表示“尽可能、尽量”。

examples.zh: 我会尽量想办法帮你的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì jǐnliàng xiǎng bànfǎ bāng nǐ de.
examples.en: I will try my best to figure out something to help you.

examples.zh: 你看书吧，我尽量不打扰你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn shū ba, wǒ jǐnliàng bù dǎrǎo nǐ.
examples.en: Go ahead and study, I'll do my best to not disturb you.

examples.zh: 你是哥哥，要尽量照顾好妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì gēge, yào jǐnliàng zhàogù hǎo mèimei.
examples.en: You are the big brother and you should try your best to look after your little sister.

examples.zh: 老板生气了，你和他说话要尽量委婉点。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shēngqì le, nǐ hé tā shuōhuà yào jǐnliàng wěiwǎn diǎn.
examples.en: The boss is angry. Be as tactful as possible with him.

title: Expressing concern with "kongpa"
structure: (Reason,) 恐怕 + Subj. ……
explanation: “恐怕”表示“恐怕、担心”，用于委婉表达坏消息或不确定的判断。

examples.zh: 今天恐怕要下雨。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kǒngpà yào xiàyǔ.
examples.en: I'm afraid it's going to rain today.

examples.zh: 这件事恐怕得你帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì kǒngpà děi nǐ bāngmáng.
examples.en: I'm afraid we're going to need your help with this matter.

examples.zh: 这样做恐怕不太合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò kǒngpà bù tài héshì.
examples.en: I'm afraid it's not appropriate to do this.

examples.zh: 恐怕没那么容易吧。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngpà méi nàme róngyì ba.
examples.en: I'm afraid it's not that easy.

title: Expressing difficulty with "hao (bu) rongyi"
structure: Subj. + 好(不)容易 + 才 + [Result]；Verb/[Verb Phrase] + 好容易/好不容易
explanation: “好不容易/好容易”表示“很不容易、费了很大劲”。

examples.zh: 她好容易才减肥成功。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo róngyì cái jiǎnféi chénggōng.
examples.en: She had a hard time losing weight and succeeded.

examples.zh: 我好不容易才打通了银行的服务热线。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái dǎtōng le yínháng de fúwù rèxiàn.
examples.en: It was no easy task to get through to the bank's customer service hotline.

examples.zh: 要完成这个大项目好不容易啊。
examples.pinyin: Yào wánchéng zhège dà xiàngmù hǎobù róngyì a.
examples.en: It's really not easy to complete this big project.

examples.zh: 养大一个孩子好不容易。
examples.pinyin: Yǎng dà yī gè háizi hǎobù róngyì.
examples.en: Raising a child is not an easy thing to do.

title: Expressing "even" with "shenzhi"
explanation: “甚至”表示“甚至”，用于强调出乎意料的极端情况。

examples.zh: 我去过很多中国的城市，北京、上海、杭州、昆明、桂林，甚至拉萨我也去过。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù guo hěn duō Zhōngguó de chéngshì, Běijīng, Shànghǎi, Hángzhōu, Kūnmíng, Guìlín, shènzhì Lāsà wǒ yě qù guo.
examples.en: I've been to many cities in China: Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Kunming, Guilin. I even went to Lhasa once.

examples.zh: 我的朋友都不喜欢我的决定，甚至我的家人也不支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou dōu bù xǐhuan wǒ de juédìng, shènzhì wǒ de jiārén yě bù zhīchí.
examples.en: None of my friends like my decision, and even my family doesn't support it.

examples.zh: 他太忙了，甚至吃中饭的时间都没有。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài máng le, shènzhì chī zhōngfàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.en: He's too busy. He doesn't even have time to eat lunch.

examples.zh: 我男朋友很喜欢游泳，甚至连冬天也游。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou hěn xǐhuan yóuyǒng, shènzhì lián dōngtiān yě yóu.
examples.en: My boyfriend likes swimming a lot. He goes swimming even when it's winter.

title: Expressing "feel free to" with "jinguan"
structure: 尽管 + Verb
explanation: “尽管”作副词表示“尽管、随便”，鼓励对方不必拘束。

examples.zh: 大家有话尽管说。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yǒu huà jǐnguǎn shuō.
examples.en: Feel free to speak up if you have anything to say.

examples.zh: 有什么问题尽管问。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme wèntí jǐnguǎn wèn.
examples.en: Feel free to ask if you have any questions.

examples.zh: 这些饮料是免费的，尽管喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē yǐnliào shì miǎnfèi de, jǐnguǎn hē.
examples.en: Feel free to help yourself to these drinks. They are all free of charge.

examples.zh: 想吃什么尽管点，我请客。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng chī shénme jǐnguǎn diǎn, wǒ qǐngkè.
examples.en: Feel free to order anything you like. My treat.

title: Expressing "have to" with "budebu"
structure: Subj. + 不得不 + Verb
explanation: “不得不”表示“不得不、只能”，比“必须”语气更强，带不情愿。

examples.zh: 你真的太厉害了，我不得不承认。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de tài lìhai le, wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn.
examples.en: You are so good. I have to admit it.

examples.zh: 电梯又坏了，我们不得不爬楼梯。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī yòu huài le, wǒmen bùdébù pá lóutī.
examples.en: The elevator is broken again. We have to take the stairs.

examples.zh: 不好意思，时间有限，我不得不打断你。
examples.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, shíjiān yǒuxiàn, wǒ bùdébù dǎduàn nǐ.
examples.en: I'm sorry, but time is very limited. I have to interrupt you.

examples.zh: 因为生病的关系，他不得不放弃这次旅行。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shēngbìng de guānxi, tā bùdébù fàngqì zhè cì lǚxíng.
examples.en: Because he was sick, he had no choice but to give up this trip.

title: Expressing "in the end / on earth" with "daodi"
structure: 到底……，Reason/Characteristic；到底 + Question Word；到底 + Verb + 不/没 + Verb；到底 + Verb + 了
explanation: “到底”可表示“毕竟/终究”、“究竟/到底（疑问强调）”、“终于”。

examples.zh: 到底是个大老板，出手就是大方。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ shì ge dà lǎobǎn, chūshǒu jiùshì dàfang.
examples.en: He is a high-level boss, after all. Look how generous he is with money.

examples.zh: 你到底怎么了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ zěnme le?
examples.en: What on earth is up with you?

examples.zh: 你到底喜不喜欢我？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ xǐ bu xǐhuan wǒ?
examples.en: Do you like me or not?

examples.zh: 天气到底暖和了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì dàodǐ nuǎnhuo le.
examples.en: The weather is finally warm.

title: Expressing "in the end" with "jiujing"
structure: 究竟 + Question Word；究竟 + Verb + 没/不 + Verb；Fact + 究竟是 + Fact
explanation: “究竟”比“到底”更正式，用于强调疑问或“毕竟是……”。

examples.zh: 这个人究竟是谁？
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén jiūjìng shì shéi?
examples.en: Who on earth is this guy?

examples.zh: 你究竟来不来？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiūjìng lái bu lái?
examples.en: Are you coming or not?

examples.zh: 孩子究竟是孩子，总是想着怎么玩。
examples.pinyin: Háizi jiūjìng shì háizi, zǒng shì xiǎng zhe zěnme wán.
examples.en: Kids are kids after all, always thinking about how to have fun.

examples.zh: 上海究竟是上海，生活成本就是高。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi jiūjìng shì Shànghǎi, shēnghuó chéngběn jiùshì gāo.
examples.en: Shanghai is Shanghai after all. The living expenses here are just high.

title: Expressing "might as well" with "gancui"
structure: Subj. + 干脆 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “干脆”表示“干脆、索性”，提出直接了当的做法。

examples.zh: 家里什么都没有，干脆出去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ shénme dōu méiyǒu, gāncuì chūqù chī ba.
examples.en: There is nothing in the house, let's just go out to eat.

examples.zh: 既然学不好，干脆别学了。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán xué bù hǎo, gāncuì bié xué le.
examples.en: Since you can't learn it, just stop studying.

examples.zh: 这台破电脑又坏了，干脆别修了，买台新的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái pò diànnǎo yòu huài le, gāncuì bié xiū le, mǎi tái xīn de ba.
examples.en: This crappy old computer broke again. Might as well not fix it and just buy a new one.

examples.zh: 既然你也喜欢这个沙发，我们干脆买回家吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yě xǐhuan zhège shāfā, wǒmen gāncuì mǎi huí jiā ba.
examples.en: Since you like this sofa too, let's just buy it and take it home.

title: Expressing "nearly" with "jihu"
structure: 几乎 + Noun Phrase + 都；几乎 + 没有 + Noun Phrase；Subj. + 几乎 + [不/没 +] Predicate
explanation: “几乎”表示“几乎、差不多”。

examples.zh: 几乎每个人都有手机。
examples.pinyin: Jīhū měi gè rén dōu yǒu shǒujī.
examples.en: Almost everyone has a cell phone.

examples.zh: 在中国，几乎所有老外都会说“你好”。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, jīhū suǒyǒu lǎowài dōu huì shuō "nǐ hǎo".
examples.en: In China, almost all foreigners can say "nihao".

examples.zh: 几乎没有人相信他。
examples.pinyin: Jīhū méiyǒu rén xiāngxìn tā.
examples.en: Almost no one believes him.

examples.zh: 爸爸的头发几乎白了。
examples.pinyin: Bàba de tóufa jīhū bái le.
examples.en: Dad's hair is almost all white.

title: Expressing "never again" with "zai ye bu"
structure: Subj. + 再也 + 不 (+ Aux.) + Verb Phrase + 了；Subj. + 再也 + 没 + Verb + 过 + Obj.
explanation: “再也不……了”表示“再也不……”；“再也没……过”表示“从那以后再也没有……过”。

examples.zh: 我再也不想看到你了！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng kàndào nǐ le!
examples.en: I never want to see you again!

examples.zh: 医生说她再也不能跳舞了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā zài yě bù néng tiàowǔ le.
examples.en: The doctor said she will never be able to dance again.

examples.zh: 从那以后，我再也没去过酒吧。
examples.pinyin: Cóng nà yǐhòu, wǒ zài yě méi qù guo jiǔbā.
examples.en: Since then, I've never been to a bar again.

examples.zh: 分手以后，他们再也没见过。
examples.pinyin: Fēnshǒu yǐhòu, tāmen zài yě méi jiàn guo.
examples.en: They haven't seen each other ever since they broke up.

similar: Expressing a last chance with "zaibu... jiu..."

title: Expressing "once" with "cengjing"
structure: Subj. + 曾经 + Verb + 过 (+ Obj.)；曾经 + 是/在/有
explanation: “曾经”表示“曾经、一度”，常与“过”搭配；用于“是/在/有”时一般不用“过”。否定用“没……过”，不能用“不/没曾经”。

examples.zh: 我们曾经一起去过。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen céngjīng yīqǐ qù guo.
examples.en: We once went there together.

examples.zh: 他说他曾经做过很多傻事。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā céngjīng zuò guo hěn duō shǎ shì.
examples.en: He said that he once did a lot of stupid things.

examples.zh: 她曾经想当演员，后来成了全职太太。
examples.pinyin: Tā céngjīng xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán, hòulái chéng le quánzhí tàitai.
examples.en: She once wanted to become an actress. She later became a stay-at-home mom.

examples.zh: 他曾经是我老板。
examples.pinyin: Tā céngjīng shì wǒ lǎobǎn.
examples.en: He was once my boss.

title: Expressing "originally" with "benlai"
structure: Subj. + 本来 + 是 + (不)[要/会/应该] + Verb + 的，但是/可是……；Subj. + 本来 + 就……
explanation: “本来”表示“原本、本来”；“本来就……”用于强调“本来就……”，常带“显而易见/早就如此”语气。

examples.zh: 我本来是要去的，不过后来不太舒服，就没去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái shì yào qù de, bùguò hòulái bù tài shūfu, jiù méi qù.
examples.en: I originally wanted to go, but I didn't go because I didn't feel very well.

examples.zh: 这些工作本来是要今天做完的，不过明天做也可以。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gōngzuò běnlái shì yào jīntiān zuò wán de, bùguò míngtiān zuò yě kěyǐ.
examples.en: This work was originally supposed to be done by today, but it's OK to do it tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你本来就够瘦了，还要减肥吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ běnlái jiù gòu shòu le, hái yào jiǎnféi ma?
examples.en: You are already so thin and you still want to lose weight?

examples.zh: 照顾孩子本来就是父母的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù háizi běnlái jiù shì fùmǔ de zérèn.
examples.en: Taking care of children is supposed to be the responsibility of parents.

title: Expressing "again and again" with "zaisan"
structure: 再三 + Verb
explanation: “再三”表示“再三、反复”，较正式，多修饰双音节动词，通常不与“了/过”连用。

examples.zh: 老师再三强调这次考试对我们很重要。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zàisān qiángdiào zhè cì kǎoshì duì wǒmen hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: The teacher has stressed over and over that this exam is really important for us.

examples.zh: 这个决定是经过再三考虑做出来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng shì jīngguò zàisān kǎolǜ zuò chūlái de.
examples.en: This decision was made after much consideration.

examples.zh: 她再三犹豫之后，选择了放弃比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zàisān yóuyù zhīhòu, xuǎnzé le fàngqì bǐsài.
examples.en: After hesitating again and again, she chose to quit the competition.

examples.zh: 我再三提醒你出国旅游一定要小心你的钱包。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zàisān tíxǐng nǐ chūguó lǚyóu yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn nǐ de qiánbāo.
examples.en: I've reminded you again and again that you need to be careful with your wallet when you travel abroad.

title: Expressing "simply" with "jianzhi"
structure: Subj. + 简直 + Predicate；Subj. + 简直是 + Predicate
explanation: “简直”表示“简直、完全”，带惊讶语气。不能直接接无修饰形容词，常用“太……了/……极了”。

examples.zh: 这里简直是天堂！
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jiǎnzhí shì tiāntáng!
examples.en: This place is simply heaven.

examples.zh: 他唱歌简直难听死了！
examples.pinyin: Tā chànggē jiǎnzhí nántīng sǐ le!
examples.en: His singing is simply awful!

examples.zh: 她简直太漂亮了！
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎnzhí tài piàoliang le!
examples.en: She is simply too pretty!

examples.zh: 他简直是骗人。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎnzhí shì piàn rén.
examples.en: He's just lying to you.

title: Expressing "always previously" with "yixiang"
structure: Subj. + 一向 + Habit/Attitude/etc.
explanation: “一向”表示“一向、一直”，强调长期习惯/态度持续到现在。不能用于变化中的动作或将来，此时用“一直”。

examples.zh: 小王一向上班很早，这次是怎么了？
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng yīxiàng shàngbān hěn zǎo, zhè cì shì zěnme le?
examples.en: Xiao Wang has always started work very early. What happened this time?

examples.zh: 我一向不喜欢点外卖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīxiàng bù xǐhuan diǎn wàimài.
examples.en: I have never liked ordering takeout.

examples.zh: 妈妈一向支持我的决定。
examples.pinyin: Māma yīxiàng zhīchí wǒ de juédìng.
examples.en: Mom has always supported my decisions.

examples.zh: 他一向是个好学生，怎么可能会作弊呢？
examples.pinyin: Tā yīxiàng shì gè hǎo xuésheng, zěnme kěnéng huì zuòbì ne?
examples.en: He's always been a good student, why would he possibly cheat?

title: Expressing "make sure to" with "qianwan"
structure: 千万 + Verb/Verb Phrase
explanation: “千万”表示“务必、千万”，用于强烈命令或提醒，常与“要/不能/别”搭配。

examples.zh: 这个菜很难吃，千万不要点！
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài hěn nánchī, qiānwàn bùyào diǎn!
examples.en: This dish is horrible. Make sure you don't order it!

examples.zh: 那里太危险了，千万不要去！
examples.pinyin: Nàlǐ tài wēixiǎn le, qiānwàn bùyào qù!
examples.en: It's too dangerous there. Make sure you don't go!

examples.zh: 过马路千万要小心。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎlù qiānwàn yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: When crossing the street, you really must be careful!

examples.zh: 出门以前千万要把门锁好。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén yǐqián qiānwàn yào bǎ mén suǒ hǎo.
examples.en: Before leaving make absolute sure to lock the door!

title: Expressing "in vain" with "bai"
structure: 白 + Verb + 了；白白 + Verb + 了；白 + 吃/喝/住（免费）
explanation: “白”作副词表示“白费、徒劳”；“白白”强调更强。“白吃/白喝/白住”表示“免费”。

examples.zh: 白花了一百块钱，这件衣服不能穿。
examples.pinyin: Bái huā le yībǎi kuài qián, zhè jiàn yīfu bù néng chuān.
examples.en: I just wasted a hundred kuai. I can't even wear these clothes.

examples.zh: 他不回来吃饭了？！我这些菜白做了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù huílái chīfàn le?! Wǒ zhèxiē cài bái zuò le.
examples.en: He's not coming back to eat?! I made all this food for nothing.

examples.zh: 明天不考中文，小王白白准备了一天。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān bù kǎo Zhōngwén, Xiǎo Wáng báibái zhǔnbèi le yī tiān.
examples.en: There's no Chinese test tomorrow. Little Wang spent the whole day studying in vain.

examples.zh: 白吃
examples.pinyin: bái chī
examples.en: to eat for free

title: Expressing "while you're at it" with "shunbian"
structure: Subj. + Verb Phrase 1，顺便 + Verb Phrase 2
explanation: “顺便”表示“顺便、顺手”，做某事时顺带做另一件事。

examples.zh: 你去买早饭的时候顺便帮我带杯咖啡吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù mǎi zǎofàn de shíhou shùnbiàn bāng wǒ dài bēi kāfēi ba.
examples.en: When you go out to get breakfast can you also bring me a cup of coffee?

examples.zh: 老板去见客户，顺便吃了午饭。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn qù jiàn kèhù, shùnbiàn chī le wǔfàn.
examples.en: The boss went to see the client and also ate lunch while he was at it.

examples.zh: 我下周去北京出差，顺便去看一个朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu qù Běijīng chūchāi, shùnbiàn qù kàn yī gè péngyou.
examples.en: I'm going to Beijing on a business trip next week. I'll go to visit a friend while I'm there.

examples.zh: 顺便说一下，我最近搬家了。
examples.pinyin: Shùnbiàn shuō yīxià, wǒ zuìjìn bānjiā le.
examples.en: By the way, I moved recently.

title: Repeated actions in the past with "you"
structure: Subj. + Verb + 了 + 又 + Verb，（还是/就是）……
explanation: “V了又V”表示过去反复做某事，常与“还是/就是”连用，强调“仍然没有改变”。

examples.zh: 这个人我看了又看，还是觉得我不认识他。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén wǒ kàn le yòu kàn, háishì juéde wǒ bù rènshi tā.
examples.en: I looked at him again and again, but I still think I don't know him.

examples.zh: 我想了又想，还是觉得不能这样做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le yòu xiǎng, háishì juéde bù néng zhèyàng zuò.
examples.en: I thought it over again and again, but I still feel I can't do this.

examples.zh: 他找了又找，还是没找到他的钱包。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎo le yòu zhǎo, háishì méi zhǎodào tā de qiánbāo.
examples.en: He searched again and again, and still couldn't find his wallet.

examples.zh: 这个方案改了又改，终于通过了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn gǎi le yòu gǎi, zhōngyú tōngguò le.
examples.en: This plan was changed again and again, and finally it was approved.

title: Rhetorical questions with "nandao"
structure: 难道 + [Rhetorical Question] + 吗？
explanation: “难道……吗？”用于反问，强调“难道……吗？”，不需要回答。只能用于是非问句，一般以“吗”结尾。

examples.zh: 难道你真的相信他吗？
examples.pinyin: Nándào nǐ zhēn de xiāngxìn tā ma?
examples.en: You don't actually believe him, do you?

examples.zh: 难道你是我妈吗？
examples.pinyin: Nándào nǐ shì wǒ mā ma?
examples.en: What are you, my mother or something?

examples.zh: 今天是我的生日，难道你不知道吗？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, nándào nǐ bù zhīdào ma?
examples.en: Today's my birthday; you're telling me you didn't know?

examples.zh: 难道你今天没去上班吗？
examples.pinyin: Nándào nǐ jīntiān méi qù shàngbān ma?
examples.en: Did you not go to work today?

title: The opposite of "chabuduo" is "cha hen duo"
structure: Subj. + 差很多；A + 跟/和 + B + 差很多
explanation: “差很多”表示“差别很大、很不一样”，是“差不多”的反义表达。

examples.zh: 中西方的文化差很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhōng xīfāng de wénhuà chà hěn duō.
examples.en: Chinese culture and western culture are quite different.

examples.zh: 这两个词的意思差不多，但是用法差很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsi chàbuduō, dànshì yòngfǎ chà hěn duō.
examples.en: The meanings of these two words are basically the same, but their usages are very different.

examples.zh: 她和她老公的年龄差很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé tā lǎogōng de niánlíng chà hěn duō.
examples.en: There is a big difference between her age and her husband's age.

examples.zh: 这两个词的意思差不多，但是用法差很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsi chàbuduō, dànshì yòngfǎ chà hěn duō.
examples.en: The meanings of these two words are basically the same, but their usages are very different.

title: Listing things with "a"
structure: A 啊，B 啊，C 啊（+ 什么的）……
explanation: “名词 + 啊”用于列举，口语化，表示“……之类的”。

examples.zh: 我们什么零食都有，花生啊，瓜子啊，薯片啊，你随便吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shénme língshí dōu yǒu, huāshēng a, guāzǐ a, shǔpiàn a, nǐ suíbiàn chī ba.
examples.en: We have all sorts of snacks: peanuts, roasted seeds, chips, go ahead and eat whatever you want.

examples.zh: 小王啊，小李啊，小张啊，他们都在公司，你可以找他们。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng a, Xiǎo Lǐ a, Xiǎo Zhāng a, tāmen dōu zài gōngsī, nǐ kěyǐ zhǎo tāmen.
examples.en: Xiao Wang, Xiao Li, and Xiao Zhang all work at the same company, you can ask them.

examples.zh: 手机有很多功能，比如说拍照啊，看视频啊，听歌啊，都可以。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī yǒu hěn duō gōngnéng, bǐrú shuō pāizhào a, kàn shìpín a, tīng gē a, dōu kěyǐ.
examples.en: Cell phones have many features like taking photos, watching videos, and listening to music. They can do it all.

examples.zh: 椅子啊，桌子啊，电脑啊什么的，都买好了，现在办公室只差招员工了！
examples.pinyin: Yǐzi a, zhuōzi a, diànnǎo a shénme de, dōu mǎi hǎo le, xiànzài bàngōngshì zhǐ chà zhāo yuángōng le!
examples.en: Chairs, tables, computers, and so on have all been bought. Now the office only needs to hire staff!

similar: Ending a non-exhaustive list with "shenme de"

title: Expressing "and then" with "yushi"
structure: [Event 1]，于是 + [Event 2]（+ 了）
explanation: “于是”表示“于是、然后”，连接两个已发生的事件，第二件事是第一件事的直接结果。只用于过去。

examples.zh: 我看大家都买了，于是我也买了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dàjiā dōu mǎi le, yúshì wǒ yě mǎi le.
examples.en: I saw everyone was buying it. So then I bought it, too.

examples.zh: 昨天突然下雨了，于是我们取消了野餐的计划。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān tūrán xiàyǔ le, yúshì wǒmen qǔxiāo le yěcān de jìhuà.
examples.en: It rained yesterday, so we cancelled the picnic.

examples.zh: 网站上的票已经卖光了，于是我们买了黄牛票。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn shang de piào yǐjīng mài guāng le, yúshì wǒmen mǎi le huángniú piào.
examples.en: The tickets on the website were all sold out. So then we bought tickets from scalpers.

examples.zh: 电影太暴力了，我们实在看不下去了，于是就走了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng tài bàolì le, wǒmen shízài kàn bu xiàqù le, yúshì jiù zǒu le.
examples.en: This movie was so violent, we couldn't bear watching it anymore. So then we left.

title: Using "er" to explain contrasting ideas
structure: 不是……，而是……；是……，而不是……；Sentence 1，而 + Sentence 2
explanation: “而”连接两个分句，表示对比/转折，相当于“而是”。较正式。

examples.zh: 我们是来办事的，而不是来玩的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì lái bànshì de, ér bù shì lái wán de.
examples.en: We're here to do work, not to have fun.

examples.zh: 以后后悔的人不是我，而是你自己。
examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu hòuhuǐ de rén bù shì wǒ, ér shì nǐ zìjǐ.
examples.en: The person to later regret this won't be me. It will be you.

examples.zh: 你这样做是害他，而不是帮他。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò shì hài tā, ér bù shì bāng tā.
examples.en: By doing this you were hurting him, not helping him.

examples.zh: 我 今天去 你家 找 你 了，而 你 不在 家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qù nǐ jiā zhǎo nǐ le, ér nǐ bù zài jiā.
examples.en: I went to your home today looking for you, but you weren't there.

similar: Expressing "not only... but also" with "budan... erqie..."

title: Expressing "among" with "dangzhong"
structure: Group/Process + 当中
explanation: “当中”表示“在……当中/中间”，可指群体中，也可指过程正在进行中。

examples.zh: 你是我所有朋友当中最聪明的一个。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ suǒyǒu péngyou dāngzhōng zuì cōngming de yī gè.
examples.en: Of all of my friends, you are the smartest one.

examples.zh: 在这一百个选手当中我表现得最出色。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè yībǎi gè xuǎnshǒu dāngzhōng wǒ biǎoxiàn de zuì chūsè.
examples.en: Among these one hundred contestants, my performance was the most outstanding.

examples.zh: 这个工程还在计划当中。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngchéng hái zài jìhuà dāngzhōng.
examples.en: This engineering project is still in the planning stage.

examples.zh: 现在还在调查当中，还不知道结果。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hái zài diàochá dāngzhōng, hái bù zhīdào jiéguǒ.
examples.en: It is still under investigation, so the result is not yet known.

title: Expressing "each other" with "bici"
structure: 彼此 + Predicate；Verb + 彼此；彼此 + 的 + Noun
explanation: “彼此”表示“彼此、互相”，可作主语、宾语、定语。

examples.zh: 我们只见过一次，彼此不是很了解。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì, bǐcǐ bù shì hěn liǎojiě.
examples.en: We've only met once. We don't know each other well.

examples.zh: 我们是一家人，必须好好照顾彼此。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì yījiā rén, bìxū hǎohǎo zhàogù bǐcǐ.
examples.en: We're a family. We must do a good job looking after each other.

examples.zh: 过去一年，我们见证了彼此的进步。
examples.pinyin: Guòqù yī nián, wǒmen jiànzhèng le bǐcǐ de jìnbù.
examples.en: Over the past year, we have witnessed each other's progress.

examples.zh: 彼此彼此！
examples.pinyin: Bǐcǐ bǐcǐ!
examples.en: Same, same!

title: Expressing "when" with "dang... shihou"
structure: 当 + Phrase (+ 时候)，……
explanation: “当……时候”表示“当……的时候”，与“的时候/时”类似。

examples.zh: 当我有自行车的时候，大家都开始骑电动车了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yǒu zìxíngchē de shíhou, dàjiā dōu kāishǐ qí diàndòngchē le.
examples.en: When I got a bike, everyone started riding electric ones.

examples.zh: 当我看到这张照片，我就想起了你。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ jiù xiǎng qǐ le nǐ.
examples.en: When I saw this photo, I immediately thought of you.

examples.zh: 当弟弟肚子饿的时候，他就会哭得很大声。
examples.pinyin: Dāng dìdi dùzi è de shíhou, tā jiù huì kū de hěn dàshēng.
examples.en: When my little brother is hungry, he will cry loudly.

examples.zh: 当你遇到困难的时候，不要怕，来找我。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, bùyào pà, lái zhǎo wǒ.
examples.en: When you encounter challenges, don't be afraid. Come find me.

title: Expressing "within (it/them)" with "qizhong"
structure: Category/Group/Context + 其中
explanation: “其中”表示“其中、在那里面”，指前面提到的人或事物中的一部分。

examples.zh: 我有四辆汽车，其中三辆都是宝马。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu sì liàng qìchē, qízhōng sān liàng dōu shì Bǎomǎ.
examples.en: I have four cars. Of them, three are BMW's.

examples.zh: 到处都有孤独的人，我只是其中一个。
examples.pinyin: Dàochù dōu yǒu gūdú de rén, wǒ zhǐ shì qízhōng yī gè.
examples.en: There are lonely people everywhere. I am just one of them.

examples.zh: 公司里有三把伞，其中两把是老板的。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lǐ yǒu sān bǎ sǎn, qízhōng liǎng bǎ shì lǎobǎn de.
examples.en: Of the three umbrellas in the office, two are the boss's.

examples.zh: 这么多人，我只认识其中的一个。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō rén, wǒ zhǐ rènshi qízhōng de yī gè.
examples.en: Of the many people, I only know one of them.

title: Using "zhege" to label / emphasize
structure: Subj. + 这个 + [Category]；Subj. + 这种/这类 + [Category]
explanation: “这个 + 名词”用于强调对某人/某物的评价，可带贬义；“这种/这类”用于类别评价。

examples.zh: 你这个坏蛋，就没做过一件好事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège huàidàn, jiù méi zuò guo yī jiàn hǎoshì.
examples.en: You're such a bad person! You haven't done a single good thing.

examples.zh: 他这个马屁精，又去拍老板的马屁了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège mǎpìjīng, yòu qù pāi lǎobǎn de mǎpì le.
examples.en: He's such a brown-noser. He's kissing up to the boss again.

examples.zh: 猕猴桃这种水果，营养价值最高。
examples.pinyin: Míhóutáo zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ, yíngyǎng jiàzhí zuì gāo.
examples.en: This fruit we call kiwifruit has a high nutritional value.

examples.zh: 抽奖这种活动，都是骗人的。
examples.pinyin: Chōujiǎng zhè zhǒng huódòng, dōu shì piàn rén de.
examples.en: Raffles and the like are all scams.

title: Advanced "le" after an object
structure: Subj. + Verb + 了 + Obj.；Subj. + Verb + Obj. + 了
explanation: “了”可放在动词后或宾语后。宾语短时更自然放宾语后；宾语长时放动词后；宾语带修饰/数量、时间地点目的、结果补语时放动词后；将来完成动作也放动词后；双“了”可强调数量大或强确认。

examples.zh: 我上课了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàngkè le.
examples.en: I had class.

examples.zh: 老师问问题了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn wèntí le.
examples.en: The teacher asked questions.

examples.zh: 他提交了今天所有的报告。
examples.pinyin: Tā tíjiāo le jīntiān suǒyǒu de bàogào.
examples.en: He has submitted all the reports for today.

examples.zh: 他们生了四个孩子了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shēng le sì gè háizi le.
examples.en: They've had four children already.

title: Advanced "le" with complements
structure: Subj. + Verb + Complement + 了；Subj. + Verb + 了 + Complement（多用于趋向补语）
explanation: 补语后加“了”最常见；动词后“了”再补语多用于书面/趋向补语。

examples.zh: 买到了。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi dào le.
examples.en: Bought it.

examples.zh: 吃完了。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán le.
examples.en: Finished eating.

examples.zh: 站了起来。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn le qǐlái.
examples.en: stood up.

examples.zh: 小妹看到妈妈不在家，哭了起来。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomèi kàndào māma bù zài jiā, kū le qǐlái.
examples.en: Xiao Mei started crying when she saw her mother wasn't home.

title: Marking a topic with "ma"
structure: Topic + 嘛，Statement
explanation: “嘛”用于标记话题，先提出话题，再发表评论，语气较随意。

examples.zh: 大熊猫嘛，大家都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióngmāo ma, dàjiā dōu xǐhuan.
examples.en: Pandas. Everybody likes them.

examples.zh: 名牌嘛，一定不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Míngpái ma, yīdìng bù piányi.
examples.en: Well, it's a name brand. It can't be cheap.

examples.zh: 第一次嘛，以后就会了。
examples.pinyin: Dì-yī cì ma, yǐhòu jiù huì le.
examples.en: It's your first time. You'll get the hang of it soon.

examples.zh: 孩子嘛，不懂这些很正常。
examples.pinyin: Háizi ma, bù dǒng zhèxiē hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.en: Kids. It's not unusual that they don't understand these things.

title: Softening the tone of questions with "ne"
structure: Option 1 + 呢 + 还是 + Option 2 + 呢？；Interrogative Pronoun + 呢？；Subj. + Verb + 不 + Verb + 呢？
explanation: “呢”用于使问句更委婉、不确定，常带“我想想/请问”的语气。

examples.zh: 我去缅甸呢，还是泰国呢？我得想一想！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Miǎndiàn ne, háishì Tàiguó ne? Wǒ děi xiǎng yi xiǎng!
examples.en: Should I go to Myanmar or Thailand? I have to think a bit!

examples.zh: 这是谁的笔呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì shéi de bǐ ne?
examples.en: I wonder whose pen this is?

examples.zh: 你去不去逛街呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù bu qù guàngjiē ne?
examples.en: Are you going to go shopping?

examples.zh: 你周末能不能加班呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò néng bu néng jiābān ne?
examples.en: Would you mind coming in on the weekend?

title: Defining upper and lower limits
structure: Amount/Level + 以上/以下；[Amount/Time/Place/Scope] + 以内/以外
explanation: “以上/以下”表示“以上/以下”；“以内/以外”表示“以内/以外”。

examples.zh: 十岁以下的孩子不用买票。
examples.pinyin: Shí suì yǐxià de háizi bùyòng mǎi piào.
examples.en: Children under the age of 10 do not need to buy tickets.

examples.zh: 我们需要有两年以上工作经验的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yǒu liǎng nián yǐshàng gōngzuò jīngyàn de rén.
examples.en: We need people with two years of working experience or more.

examples.zh: 两天以内必须完成。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng tiān yǐnèi bìxū wánchéng.
examples.en: Must be completed within two days.

examples.zh: 请你站在两米以外的地方。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhàn zài liǎng mǐ yǐwài de dìfang.
examples.en: Please stand 2 meters or more from this place.

title: Expressing "along with" with "suizhe"
structure: Subj. + 随着 + Noun + Verb Phrase；随着 + Trend，Subj. + Predicate
explanation: “随着”表示“随着、伴随”，可表示伴随动作或“随着……变化而变化”。

examples.zh: 树枝随着风不停地摇动。
examples.pinyin: Shùzhī suízhe fēng bùtíng de yáodòng.
examples.en: The branch swayed ceaselessly in the wind.

examples.zh: 孩子们随着音乐跳起了舞。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen suízhe yīnyuè tiào qǐ le wǔ.
examples.en: Children started dancing to the music.

examples.zh: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
examples.en: With economic development, the people's lives get better and better.

examples.zh: 随着年龄的增加，他变得更加成熟了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe niánlíng de zēngjiā, tā biàn de gèngjiā chéngshú le.
examples.en: As he has gotten older, he has become even more mature.

title: Expressing "ever since" with "zicong"
structure: 自从 + [Starting Point]；从/自从/自 + Time/Event + (以后/以来)
explanation: “自从”表示“自从……以来”，比“从”正式，只用于过去起点，不能用于将来或物理距离。

examples.zh: 自从来到湖南，我越来越能吃辣了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng lái dào Húnán, wǒ yuèláiyuè néng chī là le.
examples.en: Ever since arriving in Hunan I've been more and more able to eat spicy food.

examples.zh: 自从金融危机爆发，就业市场越来越不景气了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng jīnróng wēijī bàofā, jiùyè shìchǎng yuèláiyuè bù jǐngqì le.
examples.en: Ever since the economic crisis hit the job market has gotten worse and worse.

examples.zh: 自从吵完架，两个人再也没有说过话。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng chǎo wán jià, liǎng gè rén zài yě méiyǒu shuō guo huà.
examples.en: Since their fight the two of them haven't spoken at all.

examples.zh: 自改革开放以来，中国社会发生了巨大的变化。
examples.pinyin: Zì gǎigé kāifàng yǐlái, Zhōngguó shèhuì fāshēng le jùdà de biànhuà.
examples.en: Tremendous changes have been taking place in China since the reform and opening up to the outside world.

title: Expressing "from the point of view of" with "dui... er yan"
structure: 对 + [Person/Group] + 而言，……
explanation: “对……而言”表示“对……而言”，比“对……来说”更正式。

examples.zh: 这样的工作对我而言很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de gōngzuò duì wǒ ér yán hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: This kind of job, for me, is very important.

examples.zh: 对她而言，自由更重要。
examples.pinyin: Duì tā ér yán, zìyóu gèng zhòngyào.
examples.en: For her, freedom is even more important.

examples.zh: 对80后而言，网恋很正常。
examples.pinyin: Duì bāshí hòu ér yán, wǎngliàn hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.en: For people born in the eighties, Internet dating is totally normal.

examples.zh: 对老师而言，你把汉语学好，老师就很开心了。
examples.pinyin: Duì lǎoshī ér yán, nǐ bǎ Hànyǔ xué hǎo, lǎoshī jiù hěn kāixīn le.
examples.en: For the teacher, if you learn Mandarin well, that's the most satisfying.

title: Expressing "including" with "zainei"
structure: (包括)在内，……；(包括)在内
explanation: “（包括）在内”表示“包括……在内”。

examples.zh: 这些费用不包括在内。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē fèiyòng bù bāokuò zài nèi.
examples.en: These fees are not included.

examples.zh: 你把饭钱包括在内了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ fànqián bāokuò zài nèi le ma?
examples.en: Did you include your meal stipend?

examples.zh: 这件事，大家都是有责任的，包括政府在内。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì, dàjiā dōu shì yǒu zérèn de, bāokuò zhèngfǔ zài nèi.
examples.en: Everyone has responsibility in this matter, including the government.

examples.zh: 这个团队包括我在内，一共八个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì bāokuò wǒ zài nèi, yīgòng bā gè rén.
examples.en: This team, including me, has eight people altogether.

title: Expressing "on the basis of" with "ping"
structure: 凭 + Noun/Noun Phrase；凭 + Verb Phrase；凭着 + Noun/Noun Phrase
explanation: “凭”表示“凭、凭借”；“凭着”只用于已完成的动作。

examples.zh: 凭护照，外国人可以买火车票。
examples.pinyin: Píng hùzhào, wàiguórén kěyǐ mǎi huǒchē piào.
examples.en: Using a passport, foreigners can buy train tickets.

examples.zh: 他凭自己的努力学了三千多个汉字。
examples.pinyin: Tā píng zìjǐ de nǔlì xué le sānqiān duō gè Hànzì.
examples.en: He studied more than three thousand Chinese characters through his own efforts.

examples.zh: 你凭什么怪我！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ píng shénme guài wǒ!
examples.en: On what grounds are you blaming me?

examples.zh: 小白凭着自己的努力致富。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bái píngzhe zìjǐ de nǔlì zhìfù.
examples.en: On the basis of his own hard work, Xiao Bai was able to become rich.

title: Expressing passive voice with "gei"
structure: Receiver + 给 + Doer + Verb Phrase；Receiver + 被 + Doer + 给 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “给”可替代“被”表被动，更口语；“被……给……”加强被动语气。

examples.zh: 我给他骗了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā piàn le.
examples.en: I got scammed by him.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会给你浪费了。
examples.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì gěi nǐ làngfèi le.
examples.en: Such a great opportunity has been wasted by you.

examples.zh: 我的电脑被小明给弄坏了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo bèi Xiǎo Míng gěi nòng huài le.
examples.en: My computer was broken by Xiao Ming.

examples.zh: 妹妹被这个电影给吓哭了。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei bèi zhège diànyǐng gěi xià kū le.
examples.en: My younger sister was scared to tears by this movie.

title: Expressing "with regards to" with "zhiyu"
structure: 至于 + Topic，Comment
explanation: “至于”表示“至于、关于”，用于在已讨论内容后引出相关话题。

examples.zh: 项目方案我给老板了。至于老板同不同意，要看老板了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàngmù fāng'àn wǒ gěi lǎobǎn le. Zhìyú lǎobǎn tóng bu tóngyì, yào kàn lǎobǎn le.
examples.en: I've given the project proposal to my boss. It's up to him whether he agrees or not.

examples.zh: 他足球踢得不错，至于篮球，那就一般了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zúqiú tī de bùcuò, zhìyú lánqiú, nà jiù yībān le.
examples.en: He is a good soccer player, but just average at basketball.

examples.zh: 我很喜欢读书，至于什么书，没有限制。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan dúshū, zhìyú shénme shū, méiyǒu xiànzhì.
examples.en: I like reading very much. As for what books, there are no limits.

examples.zh: 我已经尽力了，至于结果只能看运气了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng jìnlì le, zhìyú jiéguǒ zhǐ néng kàn yùnqi le.
examples.en: I've already tried my best. With regards to the results, it all depends on luck.

title: Limiting scope with "jiu"
structure: Subj. + 就 + Scope + Verb + Obj.；就 + Topic + [来说/而言] + Comment
explanation: “就 + 范围 + 动词”表示“就……（方面）”；“就……来说/而言”表示“就……而言”。

examples.zh: 两国领导人就环保问题交换了意见。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎorén jiù huánbǎo wèntí jiāohuàn le yìjiàn.
examples.en: The two leaders exchanged views on environmental issues.

examples.zh: 我就这个问题说两点我的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiù zhège wèntí shuō liǎng diǎn wǒ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: I would like to make two points on this issue.

examples.zh: 就中国的独生子女政策而言，专家各有各的看法。
examples.pinyin: Jiù Zhōngguó de dúshēngzǐnǚ zhèngcè ér yán, zhuānjiā gè yǒu gè de kànfǎ.
examples.en: As for China's One Child Policy, every expert has their own opinion.

examples.zh: 就这些事情来说，他没有错。
examples.pinyin: Jiù zhèxiē shìqing lái shuō, tā méiyǒu cuò.
examples.en: In regards to these matters, he didn't do anything wrong.

title: Expressing "take advantage of" with "chen"
structure: 趁 + [Situation/Opportunity]
explanation: “趁”表示“趁、利用（机会/条件）”。

examples.zh: 趁打折，我买了新手机。
examples.pinyin: Chèn dǎzhé, wǒ mǎi le xīn shǒujī.
examples.en: Taking advantage of the discount, I bought a new phone.

examples.zh: 趁现在不忙，你快走吧。
examples.pinyin: Chèn xiànzài bù máng, nǐ kuài zǒu ba.
examples.en: Go now, while no one is busy.

examples.zh: 趁这个机会，我们见个面吧。
examples.pinyin: Chèn zhège jīhuì, wǒmen jiàn gè miàn ba.
examples.en: Let's take this opportunity to meet up.

examples.zh: 趁年轻，多去玩玩吧。
examples.pinyin: Chèn niánqīng, duō qù wánwan ba.
examples.en: You guys should go have more fun while you're still young.

title: Emphasizing a negation with "bing"
structure: Subj. + 并 + 不 + Verb/Adj.；Subj. + 并 + 没(有) + Verb
explanation: “并”用于强调否定，常带反驳/指出对方观点错误的语气。

examples.zh: 在中国创业并不容易，有很多的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó chuàngyè bìng bù róngyì, yǒu hěn duō de tiǎozhàn.
examples.en: In China, starting a business really isn't easy. There are a lot of challenges.

examples.zh: 你这样做其实并没有解决客户的问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò qíshí bìng méiyǒu jiějué kèhù de wèntí.
examples.en: What you did didn't actually solve our clients' problems at all.

examples.zh: 我并不知道你昨天给我打电话了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bìng bù zhīdào nǐ zuótiān gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le.
examples.en: I didn't know at all that you called me yesterday.

examples.zh: 你送的礼物很贵，但是我并不喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ sòng de lǐwù hěn guì, dànshì wǒ bìng bù xǐhuan.
examples.en: The gift you gave was very expensive, but I didn't like it at all.

title: Expressing "if it were not for" with "yaobushi"
structure: 要不是（的话），……
explanation: “要不是”表示“要不是……（的话）”，用于假设否定。

examples.zh: 要不是你，我会迷路。
examples.pinyin: Yàobùshì nǐ, wǒ huì mílù.
examples.en: If it weren't for you, I would get lost.

examples.zh: 要不是她帮忙，我们不可能这么快找到这个地方。
examples.pinyin: Yàobùshì tā bāngmáng, wǒmen bù kěnéng zhème kuài zhǎodào zhège dìfang.
examples.en: We couldn't have found this place so quickly without her help.

examples.zh: 要不是因为他是你朋友，我是不会帮他的。
examples.pinyin: Yàobùshì yīnwèi tā shì nǐ péngyou, wǒ shì bù huì bāng tā de.
examples.en: I wouldn't have helped him if it were not for him being your friend.

examples.zh: 要不是你们迟到的话，我们早就到了。
examples.pinyin: Yàobùshì nǐmen chídào dehuà, wǒmen zǎojiù dào le.
examples.en: We would have gotten there long ago if it were not for you all being late.

title: Expressing "thanks to" with "duokui"
structure: [Good Outcome]，多亏（了）+ [Lucky Incident]；多亏（了）+ [Lucky Incident]，Subj. 才 + [Good Outcome]；多亏（了）+ [Lucky Incident]，不然 + [Bad Outcome]
explanation: “多亏”表示“多亏、幸亏”，强调因某人/某事避免了坏结果。

examples.zh: 我能这么快做完，多亏了你帮我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ néng zhème kuài zuò wán, duōkuī le nǐ bāng wǒ.
examples.en: I was able to finish so quickly thanks to your help.

examples.zh: 我没迟到，多亏了你开车送我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi chídào, duōkuī le nǐ kāichē sòng wǒ.
examples.en: I wasn't late, thanks to you giving me a ride.

examples.zh: 多亏了你开车送我，我才没迟到。
examples.pinyin: Duōkuī le nǐ kāichē sòng wǒ, wǒ cái méi chídào.
examples.en: Thanks to your ride, I'm not late to get here.

examples.zh: 这件事情多亏了你的提醒，不然我肯定忘了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing duōkuī le nǐ de tíxǐng, bùrán wǒ kěndìng wàng le.
examples.en: Thank you for reminding me about this matter! Otherwise I would definitely have forgotten.

title: Expressing "nothing more than" with "eryi"
structure: (只是/就是/才 +) Noun + 而已；Subj. + (只是/就是/才/仅仅 +) Verb + Obj. + 而已
explanation: “而已”表示“而已、罢了”，强调“不过如此”。

examples.zh: 一杯咖啡而已，不要这么感动。
examples.pinyin: Yī bēi kāfēi éryǐ, bùyào zhème gǎndòng.
examples.en: It's just a cup of coffee, you don't need to be so moved.

examples.zh: 只是一个吻而已，没有什么特别的意思。
examples.pinyin: Jiù shì yī gè wěn éryǐ, méiyǒu shénme tèbié de yìsi.
examples.en: It was just a kiss. It didn't mean anything special.

examples.zh: 他只是开个玩笑而已，不要当真。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ shì kāi gè wánxiào éryǐ, bùyào dāngzhēn.
examples.en: He's only joking; don't take it seriously.

examples.zh: 这辆车没什么特别，它就是辆普通的汽车而已。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē méi shénme tèbié, tā jiù shì liàng pǔtōng de qìchē éryǐ.
examples.en: This car is nothing special, it's just an ordinary car.

title: Using "jiang" as a formal "ba"
structure: Subj. + 将 + Obj. + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “将”是“把”的正式书面替代，结构同“把”字句。

examples.zh: 他将这些蛋糕都吃完了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāng zhèxiē dàngāo dōu chī wán le.
examples.en: He has eaten all the cake.

examples.zh: 政府将这个房子收回了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiāng zhège fángzi shōuhuí le.
examples.en: The government has reclaimed the house.

examples.zh: 我们将竞争对手打败了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiāng jìngzhēng duìshǒu dǎbài le.
examples.en: We have defeated our competitors.

examples.zh: 公司将经常迟到的人解雇了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāng jīngcháng chídào de rén jiěgù le.
examples.en: The company dismissed the people who are always late.

title: Challenging a verb with "shenme"
structure: Verb + 什么 + Verb？；Verb + 什么 + Object？
explanation: “V什么V？”或“V什么O？”用于反问，带不耐烦/反驳语气。

examples.zh: 你买什么买，钱都花光了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi shénme mǎi, qián dōu huā guāng le.
examples.en: Buy what, now? We spent all of our money.

examples.zh: 你哭什么哭，又不是没有你的礼物。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kū shénme kū, yòu bù shì méiyǒu nǐ de lǐwù.
examples.en: What are you crying for? It's not like there's no gift for you.

examples.zh: 离什么婚！你们结婚才三个月。
examples.pinyin: Lí shénme hūn! Nǐmen jiéhūn cái sān gè yuè.
examples.en: What are you talking about, "divorce"? You've only been married three months!

examples.zh: 道什么歉啊，又不是你的错。
examples.pinyin: Dào shénme qiàn a, yòu bù shì nǐ de cuò.
examples.en: No apologies! You didn't do anything wrong.

title: Expressing "like" with "xiang"
structure: Noun 1 + 像 + Noun 2 + 一样 + Adj./Verb；Noun 1 + 不像 + Noun 2 + (这么/那么) + Adj./Verb
explanation: “像……一样”表示“像……一样”；“不像……这么/那么”表示“不像……那么……”。

examples.zh: 她有时候像小孩一样天真。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒushíhou xiàng xiǎohái yīyàng tiānzhēn.
examples.en: She's as naive as a little kid sometimes.

examples.zh: 这个老外的汉语像中国人一样地道。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎowài de Hànyǔ xiàng Zhōngguórén yīyàng dìdao.
examples.en: This foreigner can speak Chinese as fluently as native speakers do.

examples.zh: 高铁不像飞机那么快。
examples.pinyin: Gāotiě bù xiàng fēijī nàme kuài.
examples.en: High-speed trains are not as fast as airplanes.

examples.zh: 上海的冬天不像北京那么干。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi de dōngtiān bù xiàng Běijīng nàme gān.
examples.en: Winters in Shanghai are not as dry as in Beijing.

title: Comparisons with "biqi"
structure: 比起 + B (+来)，A；A + 比起 + B (+来)；相比 + B，A；和/跟/与 + B + 相比，A
explanation: “比起……来/相比……”表示“与……相比”。

examples.zh: 比起上海，我老家的物价便宜多了。
examples.pinyin: Bǐ qǐ Shànghǎi, wǒ lǎojiā de wùjià piányi duō le.
examples.en: Compared to Shanghai, the prices in my hometown are way cheaper.

examples.zh: 比起你来，我还差得远呢。
examples.pinyin: Bǐ qǐ nǐ lái, wǒ hái chà de yuǎn ne.
examples.en: Compared with you, I'm still far from it.

examples.zh: 相比网络教学，我更喜欢面对面教学。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngbǐ wǎngluò jiàoxué, wǒ gèng xǐhuan miànduìmiàn jiàoxué.
examples.en: Compared with online teaching, I prefer face-to-face teaching.

examples.zh: 与网络教学相比，我更喜欢面对面教学。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ wǎngluò jiàoxué xiāngbǐ, wǒ gèng xǐhuan miànduìmiàn jiàoxué.
examples.en: Compared with online teaching, I prefer face-to-face teaching.

title: Comparisons with "buru"
structure: A + 不如 + B；A + 不如 + B + Adj.；A + Verb + 得 + 不如 + B + Adj.；A + Verb-Obj. + 不如 + B + (Verb + 得) + Adj.；（与其……，）不如……
explanation: “不如”表示“不如、比不上”；也可表示“不如（还是）……吧”。

examples.zh: 我哥的成绩不如我的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gē de chéngjì bùrú wǒ de.
examples.en: My older brother's grades are not as good as mine.

examples.zh: 看电影不如看原著。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng bùrú kàn yuánzhù.
examples.en: Watching a movie isn't as good as reading the book.

examples.zh: 这件裙子不如那件好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn qúnzi bùrú nà jiàn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This dress doesn't look as good as that one.

examples.zh: 在家看电视多无聊！不如去KTV吧。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiā kàn diànshì duō wúliáo! Bùrú qù KTV ba.
examples.en: Watching TV at home is so boring! It'd be more fun to go do karaoke.

title: Making "-ize" and "-ify" verbs with "hua"
structure: Noun/Adj. + 化
explanation: “-化”加在名词/形容词后构成动词，相当于英语 -ize/-ify；也可作名词 -ization。

examples.zh: 中国化、美国化、个性化、数字化、城市化
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó-huà, Měiguó-huà, gèxìng-huà, shùzì-huà, chéngshì-huà
examples.en: sinicize/Chinese-ify, Americanize, personalize, digitize, urbanize

examples.zh: KFC的中国本土化经营做得非常成功。
examples.pinyin: KFC de Zhōngguó běntǔ-huà jīngyíng zuò de fēicháng chénggōng.
examples.en: KFC's Chinese localization has been implemented very successfully.

examples.zh: 你应该让黄油软化，然后跟面包一起吃。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi ràng huángyóu ruǎnhuà, ránhòu gēn miànbāo yīqǐ chī.
examples.en: You should allow the butter to soften, then eat it with bread.

examples.zh: 我们保护环境是为了美化我们的城市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎohù huánjìng shì wèile měihuà wǒmen de chéngshì.
examples.en: We protect the environment in order to beautify our city.

title: Using "nanguai" as a verb
structure: 难怪 + [Specific Person/People]
explanation: “难怪”作动词表示“不能怪、难怪”，即“不能责怪某人”。

examples.zh: 他迟到了，这也难怪。今天地铁坏了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chídào le, zhè yě nánguài. Jīntiān dìtiě huài le.
examples.en: He's late, but we can't blame him for that. The subway broke down today.

examples.zh: 难怪他，他还是个孩子呢，什么都不懂。
examples.pinyin: Nánguài tā, tā háishì gè háizi ne, shénme dōu bù dǒng.
examples.en: Don't blame him, he's just a child. He doesn't know any better.

examples.zh: 这也难怪你，第一次到这个地方还不了解这里的风俗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yě nánguài nǐ, dì-yī cì dào zhège dìfang hái bù liǎojiě zhèlǐ de fēngsú.
examples.en: No one can blame you for this. It's your first time in this place, and you aren't familiar with the local customs.

examples.zh: 如果你一定要晚上弹钢琴，那就难怪邻居抱怨你。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yīdìng yào wǎnshang tán gāngqín, nà jiù nánguài línjū bàoyuàn nǐ.
examples.en: If you insist on playing the piano at night, you can't blame the neighbors for complaining about you.

title: Expressing future with "jiang"
structure: Subj. + 将 / 将要 / 将会 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “将/将要/将会”表示“将要、将会”，较正式。

examples.zh: 他将成为一个好爸爸。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāng chéngwéi yī gè hǎo bàba.
examples.en: He will become a good father.

examples.zh: 我将永远记得你对我的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiāng yǒngyuǎn jìde nǐ duì wǒ de bāngzhù.
examples.en: I will forever remember the help you have given me.

examples.zh: 这次世界杯将在莫斯科举行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Shìjièbēi jiāng zài Mòsīkē jǔxíng.
examples.en: This World Cup will be held in Moscow.

examples.zh: 比赛结果将在月底公布。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéguǒ jiāng zài yuèdǐ gōngbù.
examples.en: The results of the competition will be announced at the end of the month.

similar: In the future in general with "yihou"

title: Combining verbs with "bing"
structure: [Verb Phrase 1] + 并 + [Verb Phrase 2]
explanation: “并/并且”连接两个动词短语，较正式，表示并列或递进。

examples.zh: 我同意并支持你的决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì bìng zhīchí nǐ de juédìng.
examples.en: I agree with and support your decision.

examples.zh: 会议讨论并通过了今年的工作计划。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì tǎolùn bìng tōngguò le jīnnián de gōngzuò jìhuà.
examples.en: The meeting discussed and approved the work plan for this year.

examples.zh: 我们会和合作公司尽快沟通并解决这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huì hé hézuò gōngsī jǐnkuài gōutōng bìng jiějué zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: We will work with the partner company to resolve this matter as soon as possible.

examples.zh: 产品经理负责和工程师合作并制定产品策略。
examples.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn jīnglǐ fùzé hé gōngchéngshī hézuò bìng zhìdìng chǎnpǐn cèlüè.
examples.en: The product manager is responsible for working with the engineers to develop the product strategy.

title: Emphasizing the doer of an action with "you"
structure: Topic + 由 + Person + Verb
explanation: “由”用于强调动作的执行者/发起者，较正式。注意“由”不是被动标记，被动用“被”。

examples.zh: 这件事由我说了算。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yóu wǒ shuō le suàn.
examples.en: This matter is up to me.

examples.zh: 这件事由我负责。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yóu wǒ fùzé.
examples.en: I am responsible for this matter.

examples.zh: 这件事是由她引起的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì yóu tā yǐnqǐ de.
examples.en: The incident was caused by her.

examples.zh: 这次的广告是由他一个人拍摄的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de guǎnggào shì yóu tā yīgèrén pāishè de.
examples.en: The advertisement was shot by him alone.

title: Expressing "hard to avoid" with "nanmian"
structure: (Subj. +) 难免 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “难免”表示“难免、不可避免”，常接“会/要”等助动词，多用于消极情况。

examples.zh: 刚开始说外语时难免会有一些误会。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ shuō wàiyǔ shí nánmiǎn huì yǒu yīxiē wùhuì.
examples.en: When you first start speaking a foreign language, there are inevitably going to be some misunderstandings.

examples.zh: 年轻人难免会遇到挫折，关键是学习怎么克服。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén nánmiǎn huì yùdào cuòzhé, guānjiàn shì xuéxí zěnme kèfú.
examples.en: Young people can't avoid facing setbacks, but the most important thing is to learn how to overcome them.

examples.zh: 现在是高峰期，地铁难免会拥挤。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shì gāofēngqī, dìtiě nánmiǎn huì yōngjǐ.
examples.en: It's rush hour right now. There's no way to avoid the congestion in the subway.

examples.zh: 刚开始工作，经验不多，难免会出错。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ gōngzuò, jīngyàn bù duō, nánmiǎn huì chūcuò.
examples.en: When you first start working, you will inevitably make mistakes because you don't have much experience.

title: Expressing "moreover" with "bingqie"
structure: [Verb Phrase 1] + 并且/并 + [Verb Phrase 2]；[Verb Phrase 1] + 并且 + 也/还 + [Verb Phrase 2]；不但/不仅 + [Verb Phrase 1] + 并且 + 也/还 + [Verb Phrase 2]
explanation: “并且”连接两个动词短语，可表示并列或递进“而且/并且”。简单并列时可用“并”替换；带“也/还”或“不但/不仅”时不能替换。

examples.zh: 我同意并且支持你的决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì bìngqiě zhīchí nǐ de juédìng.
examples.en: I agree with and support your decision.

examples.zh: 我会帮你找到问题并且解决问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì bāng nǐ zhǎodào wèntí bìngqiě jiějué wèntí.
examples.en: I can help you find the problem and also solve it.

examples.zh: 我通知了所有的人，并且还准备了所有的材料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngzhī le suǒyǒu de rén, bìngqiě hái zhǔnbèi le suǒyǒu de cáiliào.
examples.en: I have informed everyone. Moreover, I have prepared all of the materials.

examples.zh: 我们不但负责安装，并且，还维护这个系统。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bùdàn fùzé ānzhuāng, bìngqiě, hái wéihù zhège xìtǒng.
examples.en: We're in charge of installing and also maintaining this system.

title: Expressing "to be worth" doing with "zhide"
structure: 值得 + Verb/Verb Phrase；(Verb Phrase +) 值得
explanation: “值得”表示“值得做某事”，也可单独作谓语。注意不能用于“值多少钱”，那用“值”。

examples.zh: 巴金的散文很值得一看。
examples.pinyin: Bājīn de sǎnwén hěn zhídé yī kàn.
examples.en: Ba Jin's prose deserves a look.

examples.zh: 虽然不容易，但是值得去尝试。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán bù róngyì, dànshì zhídé qù chángshì.
examples.en: It's not easy, but it's worth a try.

examples.zh: 这件小事不值得你担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn xiǎo shì bù zhídé nǐ dānxīn.
examples.en: This little thing isn't worth your time.

examples.zh: 上大学很值得。
examples.pinyin: Shàng dàxué hěn zhídé.
examples.en: Going to college is really worth it.

title: Indicating negative impact with "haide"
structure: Reason，害(得) + Undesirable Situation
explanation: “害得”表示“害得、使得（造成不好的结果）”，带抱怨/责怪语气。

examples.zh: 下午喝了两杯咖啡，害得我晚上睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ hē le liǎng bēi kāfēi, hàide wǒ wǎnshang shuì bu zháo.
examples.en: I had two cups of coffee. It kept me from falling asleep at night.

examples.zh: 外面太吵了，害得我们没办法专心工作。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài chǎo le, hàide wǒmen méi bànfǎ zhuānxīn gōngzuò.
examples.en: It's too noisy outside. It's keeping us from focusing on work.

examples.zh: 你昨晚没回来，电话也打不通，害得我担心了一个晚上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuówǎn méi huílái, diànhuà yě dǎ bu tōng, hàide wǒ dānxīn le yī gè wǎnshang.
examples.en: You didn't come back last night, and I couldn't reach you by phone. You made me worry about you all night.

examples.zh: 路上堵车，害得我差点错过飞机。
examples.pinyin: Lùshang dǔchē, hàide wǒ chàdiǎn cuòguò fēijī.
examples.en: Traffic was really bad, and almost made me miss my flight.

title: Passive verbs with "shou"
structure: 受 + (Someone/Something) + Verb；受 (+ 到/过) + ([Something/Someone] +) Noun/Verb
explanation: “受”可作被动标记，相当于“被”；也可作动词表示“受到/遭受”。

examples.zh: 张老师的课很受学生的欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng Lǎoshī de kè hěn shòu xuésheng de huānyíng.
examples.en: Teacher Zhang's lessons are welcomed by the students.

examples.zh: 一个人不一定要变得很有钱或者很成功才会受人尊重。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè rén bù yīdìng yào biàn de hěn yǒu qián huòzhě hěn chénggōng cái huì shòu rén zūnzhòng.
examples.en: A person doesn't have to be rich or successful to be respected.

examples.zh: 张老师的课受到了很多学生的欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng Lǎoshī de kè shòudào le hěn duō xuésheng de huānyíng.
examples.en: Teacher Zhang's lessons received many students' approval.

examples.zh: 我父母都没受过很好的教育。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ dōu méi shòu guo hěn hǎo de jiàoyù.
examples.en: Neither of my parents has received a very good education.

title: Using "zhe" when "verbing away"
structure: Verb + 着 + Verb + 着 + 就 + Comment + 了
explanation: “V着V着就……了”表示动作持续一段时间后，出现了新情况。

examples.zh: 说着说着我就发现自己也糊涂了。
examples.pinyin: Shuōzhe shuōzhe wǒ jiù fāxiàn zìjǐ yě hútu le.
examples.en: After talking and talking, I realized that I had confused myself.

examples.zh: 我今天一直都在看《论语》，看着看着，就睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yīzhí dōu zài kàn 《Lúnyǔ》, kànzhe kànzhe, jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.en: Today, I was reading the Confucian Analects all day. As I was reading, I fell asleep.

examples.zh: 我在北京的胡同里走着走着就走丢了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng de hútòng li zǒuzhe zǒuzhe jiù zǒu diū le.
examples.en: Walking and walking in Beijing's back alleys, I got lost.

examples.zh: 我玩着玩着游戏，就把时间忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wánzhe wánzhe yóuxì, jiù bǎ shíjiān wàng le.
examples.en: I played and played the game, and I forgot the time.

title: Expressing "especially" with "gewai"
structure: 格外 (地 +) + Adjective/Psychological Verb
explanation: “格外”表示“格外、特别”，只能作副词，不能作形容词。

examples.zh: 下过雨的早晨格外舒服。
examples.pinyin: Xià guo yǔ de zǎochén géwài shūfu.
examples.en: It's especially comfortable on mornings after a rain.

examples.zh: 今天格外忙，都来不及吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān géwài máng, dōu láibují chī wǔfàn.
examples.en: I was especially busy today and didn't even have time to eat lunch.

examples.zh: 去年孩子还很调皮，但是今年格外懂事。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián háizi hái hěn tiáopí, dànshì jīnnián géwài dǒngshì.
examples.en: Last year the kid was very naughty, but this year he's been especially sensible.

examples.zh: 老师对我们格外热情。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì wǒmen géwài rèqíng.
examples.en: The teacher is especially warm to us.

title: Expressing "although" with "jinguan"
structure: 尽管……，(可是/但是 +) Subj. + 还是……
explanation: “尽管”表示“尽管、虽然”，比“虽然”更强，常与“还是”搭配。

examples.zh: 尽管很多人批评他，他还是坚持这么做。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn hěn duō rén pīpíng tā, tā háishì jiānchí zhème zuò.
examples.en: Despite the fact that many people criticize him, he still insists on doing it.

examples.zh: 尽管老板最近不在，我们还是不能偷懒。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn lǎobǎn zuìjìn bù zài, wǒmen háishì bù néng tōulǎn.
examples.en: Despite the fact that the boss hasn't been around lately, we still can't get lazy.

examples.zh: 尽管困难很多，但是我们不能放弃。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnan hěn duō, dànshì wǒmen bù néng fàngqì.
examples.en: Even though there are many difficulties, we can't just give up.

examples.zh: 尽管我很生气，但是我没发脾气。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ hěn shēngqì, dànshì wǒ méi fā píqi.
examples.en: Even though I was angry, I didn't lose my temper.

title: Expressing contrariness with "dao"
structure: ……，Subj. + 倒 + (也/又)……；Subj. + 倒……，不过/但是/就是……
explanation: “倒”表示与预期相反，常后接积极评价；也可表示让步“倒是不错，不过……”。

examples.zh: 我帮他，倒不是因为喜欢他，是因为他工作很努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bāng tā, dào bù shì yīnwèi xǐhuan tā, shì yīnwèi tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: I helped him not because I liked him, but because he worked very hard.

examples.zh: 他不是努力，成绩倒也不错。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù shì hěn nǔlì, chéngjì dào yě bùcuò.
examples.en: He's not very hard-working, but his scores also aren't bad.

examples.zh: 我倒是想去旅游，但是现在太忙了，没有时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào shì xiǎng qù lǚyóu, dànshì xiànzài tài máng le, méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.en: I do want to go on a trip, but I am too busy to do so now.

examples.zh: 这篇文章的内容倒不错，就是太长了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de nèiróng dào bùcuò, jiùshì tài cháng le.
examples.en: The content of this article is great, but it's just too long.

title: Expressing "on the contrary" with "fan'er"
structure: ……，Subj. + 反而 + [Unexpected Outcome]；……，Subj. [不但/不仅] + [不/没]……，反而 + [Unexpected Outcome]
explanation: “反而”表示“反而、相反”，强调结果与预期相反。注意“反而”是副词，放在主语后、动词前。

examples.zh: 吃了这个药，病反而更严重了。
examples.pinyin: Chī le zhège yào, bìng fǎn'ér gèng yánzhòng le.
examples.en: After taking the medicine, the illness actually got even worse.

examples.zh: 这个新系统反而降低了我们的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn xìtǒng fǎn'ér jiàngdī le wǒmen de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.en: This new system actually reduced our work efficiency.

examples.zh: 吃了药，病不但没好，反而更严重了。
examples.pinyin: Chī le yào, bìng bùdàn méi hǎo, fǎn'ér gèng yánzhòng le.
examples.en: After taking the medicine, the illness not only didn't get better, but actually got even worse.

examples.zh: 他不但不帮我，反而给我找麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùdàn bù bāng wǒ, fǎn'ér gěi wǒ zhǎo máfan.
examples.en: He not only didn't help me, but rather gave me trouble.

title: The "however" adverb "que"
structure: Sentence，(但是 +) Subj. + 却……
explanation: “却”表示“却、然而”，强调与预期相反，常后接否定评价。注意“却”是副词，放在主语后、动词前。

examples.zh: 他是老板，却没有人听他的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì lǎobǎn, què méiyǒu rén tīng tā de.
examples.en: He's the boss, but nobody listens to him.

examples.zh: 他的学历很高，能力却很一般。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xuélì hěn gāo, nénglì què hěn yībān.
examples.en: He's very well-educated, but his ability is average.

examples.zh: 他们一见钟情，却没有在一起。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yījiànzhōngqíng, què méiyǒu zài yīqǐ.
examples.en: They fell in love at first sight, but they didn't end up with each other.

examples.zh: 这件衣服虽然是名牌，但是质量却不怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu suīrán shì míngpái, dànshì zhìliàng què bù zěnmeyàng.
examples.en: Although this clothing is brand-name, the quality is not so good.

title: Expressing "due to..." with "youyu"
structure: 由于 + Cause，Effect
explanation: “由于”表示“由于、因为”，较正式。

examples.zh: 由于温室效应的影响，全球的气候变得越来越反常了。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wēnshì xiàoyìng de yǐngxiǎng, quánqiú de qìhòu biàn de yuèláiyuè fǎncháng le.
examples.en: Due to the influence of the greenhouse effect, the whole Earth's climate is getting more and more abnormal.

examples.zh: 由于意见不一致，两位老板吵了起来。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìjiàn bù yīzhì, liǎng wèi lǎobǎn chǎo le qǐlái.
examples.en: Due to differing opinions, the two bosses started to argue.

examples.zh: 由于公司的需要，我们打算再招聘一些新的员工。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngsī fāzhǎn de xūyào, wǒmen dǎsuàn zài zhāopìn yīxiē xīn de yuángōng.
examples.en: Due to our company's needs for development, we plan to hire more new staff.

examples.zh: 由于天气原因，所有的航班都要推迟起飞。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, suǒyǒu de hángbān dōu yào tuīchí qǐfēi.
examples.en: All departing flights have been postponed due to weather conditions.

similar: Emphasizing the doer of an action with "you"
Stating the effect before the cause

title: Expressing "since" with "jiran"
structure: 既然 + Fact，[那/就/那就] + Suggestion/Inference；既然 + Fact，(那 +) Rhetorical Question
explanation: “既然”表示“既然”，后接建议、推论或反问。

examples.zh: 你既然不想说，那就别说了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bù xiǎng shuō, nà jiù bié shuō le.
examples.en: Since you don't want to say, then just don't say.

examples.zh: 既然你那么喜欢，那就买吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuan, nà jiù mǎi ba.
examples.en: Since you like it so much, just buy it.

examples.zh: 你既然不喜欢他，为什么还想跟他出去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bù xǐhuan tā, wèishénme hái xiǎng gēn tā chūqù?
examples.en: Since you don't like him, why would you go out with him?

examples.zh: 既然你已经决定了，为什么现在后悔？
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ yǐjīng juédìng le, wèishénme xiànzài hòuhuǐ?
examples.en: Since you've already made your decision, why regret it now?

title: Expressing "therefore" with "yinci"
structure: Cause，+ 因此 + Effect
explanation: “因此”表示“因此、所以”，较正式，多用于书面。

examples.zh: 我病了，因此心情不好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bìng le, yīncǐ xīnqíng bù hǎo.
examples.en: I am sick, therefore I am not in a good mood.

examples.zh: 昨天下雨了，因此我没有出门。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ le, yīncǐ wǒ méiyǒu chūmén.
examples.en: It rained yesterday, therefore I did not go out.

examples.zh: 她在农村长大，因此很了解农民的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nóngcūn zhǎngdà, yīncǐ hěn liǎojiě nóngmín de shēnghuó.
examples.en: She grew up in the country, so she understands the country people's way of life.

examples.zh: 我没有准备好所有的东西，因此有些紧张。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu zhǔnbèi hǎo suǒyǒu de dōngxi, yīncǐ yǒuxiē jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: I didn't fully prepare everything, so I was a little nervous.

title: Stating the effect before the cause
structure: 之所以……，是 + 因为/为了/想……
explanation: “之所以……是因为/为了/想……”表示“之所以……是因为……”，先结果后原因，较正式。

examples.zh: 她之所以问这么多是为了多关心你们。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhīsuǒyǐ wèn zhème duō shì wèile duō guānxīn nǐmen.
examples.en: The reason she asks so many questions is in order to care about you guys.

examples.zh: 我之所以不喜欢他是因为他太疯狂了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīsuǒyǐ bù xǐhuan tā shì yīnwèi tā tài fēngkuáng le.
examples.en: The reason why I don't like him is because he's too crazy.

examples.zh: 我们之所以迟到了是因为路上堵车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhīsuǒyǐ chídào le shì yīnwèi lùshang dǔchē.
examples.en: The reason we were late is because we were stuck in a traffic jam.

examples.zh: 小朋友之所以哭是因为我没有给她买巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou zhīsuǒyǐ kū shì yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu gěi tā mǎi qiǎokèlì.
examples.en: The reason the child is crying is because I didn't buy her chocolate.

title: Advanced degree complements
structure: Adj. + 得 + 很；Adj. + 得 + 不得了；Adj. + 得 + 要命；Adj. + 得 + 不行
explanation: 形容词后可接多种程度补语，表示“非常/极其”。

examples.zh: 这个孩子自私得很。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi zìsī de hěn.
examples.en: This child is super selfish.

examples.zh: 我爸爸固执得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba gùzhí de bùdéliǎo.
examples.en: My father is awfully stubborn.

examples.zh: 我儿子淘气得要命。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ érzi táoqì de yàomìng.
examples.en: My son is incredibly naughty.

examples.zh: 我的牙痛得不行！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yá tòng de bùxíng!
examples.en: My teeth hurt so badly!

title: Advanced potential complements
structure: Verb + 得了/不了；Verb + 得下/不下；Verb + 得起/不起；Verb + 得动/不动；Verb + 得着/不着
explanation: 可能补语的扩展用法：-得了/不了（能否做到）、-得下/不下（能否容纳）、-得起/不起（能否负担）、-得动/不动（有无体力）、-得着/不着（能否达到/接触）。

examples.zh: 今晚我有事，去不了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn wǒ yǒushì, qù bùliǎo.
examples.en: I have things to do tonight. I won't be able to go.

examples.zh: 你包里放得下那么多东西吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bāo li fàng dexià nàme duō dōngxi ma?
examples.en: Can your bag hold that many things?

examples.zh: 这家餐厅太贵了，我们吃不起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng tài guì le, wǒmen chī buqǐ.
examples.en: This restaurant is too expensive. We can't afford to eat here.

examples.zh: 我走不动了，我们休息一下吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǒu budòng le, wǒmen xiūxi yīxià ba!
examples.en: I can't keep going. I need to rest a bit.

title: Advanced result complements "zhu", "kai", and "chulai"
structure: Verb + 住；Verb + 开；Verb + 出(来)
explanation: “住”表示停住/牢固；“开”表示打开/散开/想开；“出(来)”表示产生/想出/辨认出。

examples.zh: 站住！
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhù!
examples.en: Stop!

examples.zh: 一定要记住我的话。
examples.pinyin: Yīdìng yào jìzhù wǒ de huà.
examples.en: You must remember what I said.

examples.zh: 走开！
examples.pinyin: Zǒukāi!
examples.en: Go away!

examples.zh: 你能想出什么好办法？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng xiǎngchū shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.en: What good ideas can you come up with?

title: Advanced uses of direction complement "-qilai"
structure: Verb + 起来；Subj. + 把 + Obj. + Verb + 起来
explanation: “起来”可表示把东西收拢/加起来、结合/团结/回忆等抽象“聚起来”。

examples.zh: 13和15加起来是多少？
examples.pinyin: Shísān hé shíwǔ jiā qǐlái shì duōshǎo?
examples.en: How much are 13 and 15 added up?

examples.zh: 他把衣服都收起来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yīfu dōu shōu qǐlái le.
examples.en: He put away the clothes.

examples.zh: 这两个颜色搭配起来很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè yánsè dāpèi qǐlái hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: These two colors look great when you combine them.

examples.zh: 如果你把工作和兴趣结合起来，工作就会很快乐。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bǎ gōngzuò hé xìngqù jiéhé qǐlái, gōngzuò jiù huì hěn kuàilè.
examples.en: If you combine your work with your interests, working will be fun.

title: Complement "-huai le"
structure: Adj. + 坏了
explanation: “坏了”作程度补语，表示“极其……”，可褒可贬。

examples.zh: 大家都累坏了。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu lèi huài le.
examples.en: Everyone was dead-tired.

examples.zh: 我早饭和中饭都没吃，饿坏了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎofàn hé zhōngfàn dōu méi chī, è huài le.
examples.en: I didn't eat anything for breakfast or lunch. I'm starved to death.

examples.zh: 孩子不见了，妈妈急坏了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bùjiàn le, māma jí huài le.
examples.en: The child is missing. The mother is worried sick.

examples.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家都高兴坏了。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā dōu gāoxìng huài le.
examples.en: Everyone was thrilled to hear the good news.

title: Complement "-zhao"
structure: Verb + 着（zháo）；Verb + 得着/不着
explanation: “着（zháo）”作结果补语表示达到目的/有结果；作可能补语“V得着/V不着”表示能否达到/接触到。

examples.zh: 宝宝刚睡着。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao gāng shuìzháo.
examples.en: The baby just fell asleep.

examples.zh: 你的手机找着了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī zhǎozháo le ma?
examples.en: Did you find your cell phone?

examples.zh: 现在买不着这样的衣服了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài mǎi buzháo zhèyàng de yīfu le.
examples.en: You can't buy such clothes now.

examples.zh: 晚上我睡不着的时候就看书。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ shuì buzháo de shíhou jiù kànshū.
examples.en: At night when I can't get to sleep, I read a book.

title: Tricky uses of "dao"
structure: Verb + 到
explanation: “到”作结果补语，强调“达到/实现结果”。不加“到”可能只表示“尝试做”，加“到”表示结果实现。

examples.zh: 我还没有做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méiyǒu zuò.
examples.en: I haven't done it.

examples.zh: 我相信你一定能做到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng zuòdào.
examples.en: I believe you will be able to do it.

examples.zh: 我没买到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi mǎidào.
examples.en: I wasn't able to buy it.

examples.zh: 在这个公司工作，我学到了很多东西。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège gōngsī gōngzuò, wǒ xuédào le hěn duō dōngxi.
examples.en: Working for this company, I learned a lot of things.

title: Using "lai" and "qu" when "verbing around"
structure: Verb + 来 + Verb + 去
explanation: “V来V去”表示“来回/到处做某事”，同一动词重复。

examples.zh: 学生们都很紧张，在考场外面走来走去。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen dōu hěn jǐnzhāng, zài kǎochǎng wàimiàn zǒu lái zǒu qù.
examples.en: The students are all nervous, they are all pacing back and forth outside of the exam room.

examples.zh: 他说来说去还不承认自己错了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō lái shuō qù hái bù chéngrèn zìjǐ cuò le.
examples.en: He's been yakking a lot, but he still hasn't admitted that he's wrong.

examples.zh: 我想来想去都想不明白，他怎么能那样对我？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù dōu xiǎng bù míngbai, tā zěnme néng nàyàng duì wǒ?
examples.en: I've thought and thought about it, but I can't understand, how could he treat me like that?

examples.zh: 他翻来翻去，终于找到了那双破袜子。
examples.pinyin: Tā fān lái fān qù, zhōngyú zhǎodào le nà shuāng pò wàzi.
examples.en: He searched everywhere and finally found the pair of worn-out socks.

title: Expressing "as long as" with "zhiyao"
structure: 只要 + Condition，就 + Result
explanation: “只要……就……”表示“只要……就……”，必要条件。

examples.zh: 只要你真的喜欢，我就给你买。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ zhēnde xǐhuan, wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi.
examples.en: As long as you really like it, I will buy it for you.

examples.zh: 只要你努力学习，就会有进步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì xuéxí, jiù huì yǒu jìnbù.
examples.en: As long as you study hard, you'll make progress.

examples.zh: 只要有你在，我就放心了。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu nǐ zài, wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.
examples.en: As long as you are here, I won't be worried.

examples.zh: 只要下雨，她就会心情不好。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào xiàyǔ, tā jiù huì xīnqíng bù hǎo.
examples.en: Whenever it rains, she will be in a bad mood.

title: Expressing "once... then..." with "yidan... jiu..."
structure: 一旦 + Condition，Subj. + 就 + Consequence

examples.zh: 一旦发生事故，你要负责！
examples.pinyin: Yīdàn fāshēng shìgù, nǐ yào fùzé!
examples.en: In case of an accident, you're responsible!

examples.zh: 有些人一旦有了钱，就变了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén yīdàn yǒu le qián, jiù biàn le.
examples.en: Some people change as soon as they have money.

examples.zh: 一旦你的公司上市，你就可以变成有钱人。
examples.pinyin: Yīdàn nǐ de gōngsī shàngshì, nǐ jiù kěyǐ biànchéng yǒuqiánrén.
examples.en: Once your company goes public, you'll be a rich man.

examples.zh: 一旦提高价格，你会失去很多客户的。
examples.pinyin: Yīdàn tígāo jiàgé, nǐ huì shīqù hěn duō kèhù de.
examples.en: If you raise your prices, you will lose a lot of customers.

similar: Events in quick succession with "yi... jiu..."

title: Expressing "only after" with "cai"
explanation: “才”表示“只有……才/直到……才”，前半常含“花费时间/金钱/努力”等困难，后半是最终结果。

examples.zh: 我花了八千块才买到了旅游的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le bāqiān kuài cái mǎi dào le lǚyóu de dōngxi.
examples.en: Only after spending 8000 RMB was I able to buy all the things for the trip.

examples.zh: 那本书我看了两遍才看懂。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn cái kàndǒng.
examples.en: I had to read that book twice to understand it.

examples.zh: 她做完了功课才睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò wán le gōngkè cái shuìjiào.
examples.en: Not until she finished her homework did she go to sleep.

examples.zh: 他锁上了门才想起来没有带钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā suǒ shàng le mén cái xiǎng qǐlái méiyǒu dài yàoshi.
examples.en: He didn't realize he had forgotten to bring his key until after he had locked the door.

title: Expressing "only if" with "zhiyou"
structure: 只有 + Essential Condition + 才(能) + Desired Outcome；Noun + 才 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “只有……才……”表示“只有……才……”；短式“N才V”强调“才是……”。

examples.zh: 只有努力才能做好工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǔlì cái néng zuò hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.en: Only if you work hard is it possible to do a good job.

examples.zh: 只有多说，你的中文才会提高。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu duō shuō, nǐ de Zhōngwén cái huì tígāo.
examples.en: Only if you speak more will your Chinese improve.

examples.zh: 只有写完你的作业才能看电视。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu xiě wán nǐ de zuòyè cái néng kàn diànshì.
examples.en: Only if you finish your homework can you watch TV.

examples.zh: 你才是笨蛋！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cái shì bèndàn!
examples.en: YOU're the idiot!

title: Expressing "unless" with "chufei"
structure: Result/Fact，除非 + Condition；除非 + Condition，[否则/不然] + [Result/Fact]；除非 + Condition，才 + Result
explanation: “除非”表示“除非”，常与“否则/不然/才”搭配。

examples.zh: 我不去，除非你也去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù qù, chúfēi nǐ yě qù.
examples.en: I won't go unless you go too.

examples.zh: 你不能进，除非你有预约。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng jìn, chúfēi nǐ yǒu yùyuē.
examples.en: You can't come in unless you have an appointment.

examples.zh: 除非你是会员，否则不能进去。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ shì huìyuán, fǒuzé bù néng jìnqù.
examples.en: Unless you have a membership, you can't come in.

examples.zh: 除非你们买很多，才能便宜点。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi nǐmen mǎi hěn duō, cái néng piányi diǎn.
examples.en: Only if you buy a lot can I give you a cheaper price.

title: Expressing "even if..." with "jishi"
explanation: “即使……也……”表示“即使……也……”，前半为假设，后半为结果。

examples.zh: 即使你不想让我去，我也要去。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐ bù xiǎng ràng wǒ qù, wǒ yě yào qù.
examples.en: Even if you don't want me to go, I still have to go.

examples.zh: 即使冬天很冷，杰克也不穿外套。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ dōngtiān hěn lěng, Jiékè yě bù chuān wàitào.
