examples.en: Even if it is very cold in winter, Jake won't wear a jacket.

examples.zh: 即使他没钱，我也要嫁给他。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ tā méi qián, wǒ yě yào jià gěi tā.
examples.en: Even if he doesn't have money, I'm still going to marry him.

examples.zh: 即使你很有钱，也买不到幸福。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ nǐ hěn yǒuqián, yě mǎi bù dào xìngfú.
examples.en: Even if you were very rich, you couldn't buy happiness.

title: Expressing "even if..." with "jiushi"
structure: 就是 + Hypothetical Statement + 也 + Action
explanation: “就是……也……”表示“即使……也……”，用于假设。

examples.zh: 就是这台电脑价格上万，我也会买。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì zhè tái diànnǎo jiàgé shàng wàn, wǒ yě huì mǎi.
examples.en: Even if this computer's price is over 10,000 yuan, I'm still going to buy it.

examples.zh: 就是降温了，我也要穿热裤，时尚嘛！
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì jiàngwēn le, wǒ yě yào chuān rèkù, shíshàng ma!
examples.en: Even if the temperature is dropping, I'm still going to wear hot pants. They're fire!

examples.zh: 就是他变成一个穷光蛋，我也愿意跟他在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì tā biànchéng yī gè qióngguāngdàn, wǒ yě yuànyì gēn tā zài yīqǐ.
examples.en: Even if he were penniless, I would still be willing to be with him.

examples.zh: 就是以后会失败，我也想尝试。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì yǐhòu huì shībài, wǒ yě xiǎng chángshì.
examples.en: Even if it's going to fail, I want to give it a try.

title: Expressing "even if..." with "jiusuan"
structure: 就算……，也……；就算 + 再 + Adj.，也……
explanation: “就算……也……”表示“就算/即使……也……”，口语，常带“不太可能/不合理”的语气。

examples.zh: 就算你不想听，我也要说。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ bù xiǎng tīng, wǒ yě yào shuō.
examples.en: Even if you don't want to listen, I still need to say it.

examples.zh: 就算你说得都是真的，我们也没办法证明。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ shuō de dōu shì zhēn de, wǒmen yě méi bànfǎ zhèngmíng.
examples.en: Even if what you say is true, we still don't have any way to prove it.

examples.zh: 就算会失败，我也不后悔。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn huì shībài, wǒ yě bù hòuhuǐ.
examples.en: Even if I fail, I won't regret it.

examples.zh: 就算再穷，她也不去要饭。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn zài qióng, tā yě bù qù yàofàn.
examples.en: She never went on the street to beg for money no matter how poor she was.

title: Expressing "even if..." with "napa"
structure: 哪怕……，也……；哪怕 + [Subj. 1] + 再……，[Subj. 2] + 也……
explanation: “哪怕……也……”表示“哪怕/即使……也……”，语气比“即使/就算”更强。

examples.zh: 哪怕他不说，我也会知道。
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà tā bù shuō, wǒ yě huì zhīdào.
examples.en: Even if he doesn't say, I'll still find out.

examples.zh: 哪怕你什么礼物都没买，她也会很开心的。
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà nǐ shénme lǐwù dōu méi mǎi, tā yě huì hěn kāixīn de.
examples.en: It would make her really happy even if you didn't buy any present.

examples.zh: 哪怕他爸爸是总统，我也不会嫁给他！
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà tā bàba shì zǒngtǒng, wǒ yě bù yào jià gěi tā!
examples.en: I wouldn't marry him even if his father were the president!

examples.zh: 哪怕再忙，我也要健身。
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà zài máng, wǒ yě yào jiànshēn.
examples.en: Even if I'm super busy, I will still find some time to work out.

title: Expressing "if... then..." with "jiaru"
structure: 假如 + Statement + 就 + Result
explanation: “假如……就……”表示“假如……就……”，比“要是/如果”正式。

examples.zh: 假如你的成绩再好一点儿，你就能申请北大了。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ de chéngjì zài hǎo yīdiǎnr, nǐ jiù néng shēnqǐng Běidà le.
examples.en: If your grades come up a little more, then you can apply to Beijing University.

examples.zh: 假如我是你，我就戒烟。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú wǒ shì nǐ, wǒ jiù jièyān.
examples.en: If I were you, I would give up smoking.

examples.zh: 假如你的女朋友不爱你，你们就分手吧。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ de nǚpéngyou bù ài nǐ, nǐmen jiù fēnshǒu ba.
examples.en: If your girlfriend doesn't love you, then you should break up.

examples.zh: 假如有一点机会，我就会辞去现在的工作。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú yǒu yīdiǎn jīhuì, wǒ jiù huì cíqù xiànzài de gōngzuò.
examples.en: If I just had some other opportunity, I would quit my job.

title: Expressing "if... then..." with "yaoshi"
structure: 要是 + Subj. ……，就 ……；要不是……，……
explanation: “要是……就……”表示“如果……就……”，口语，北方常用；“要不是”表示“要不是……”。

examples.zh: 你要是真想我，就给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi zhēn xiǎng wǒ, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: If you do miss me, then give me a call.

examples.zh: 要是我妈知道这件事，我就死定了！
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi wǒ mā zhīdào zhè jiàn shì, wǒ jiù sǐ dìng le!
examples.en: If my mother knew about this, I would be so dead!

examples.zh: 要是老板不同意，我们就不能跟客户签合同。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi lǎobǎn bù tóngyì, wǒmen jiù bù néng gēn kèhù qiān hétóng.
examples.en: If the boss doesn't agree, then we can't sign the contract with the client.

examples.zh: 要不是他求我，我才不帮你呢。
examples.pinyin: Yàobùshì tā qiú wǒ, wǒ cái bù bāng nǐ ne.
examples.en: If it weren't because he begged me, I wouldn't be helping you.

title: Expressing "what if" with "wanyi"
structure: 万一……怎么办？；万一……呢？；万一……，……；以防万一
explanation: “万一”表示“万一、以防”，用于不太可能但不想发生的情况。

examples.zh: 万一我父母不同意呢？
examples.pinyin: Wànyī wǒ fùmǔ bù tóngyì ne?
examples.en: What if my parents disapprove?

examples.zh: 万一被发现了怎么办？
examples.pinyin: Wànyī bèi fāxiàn le zěnme bàn?
examples.en: What if we get caught?

examples.zh: 万一迷路了，就用地图导航。
examples.pinyin: Wànyī mílù le, jiù yòng dìtú dǎoháng.
examples.en: In case you get lost, use the map's GPS navigation.

examples.zh: 多带点现金吧，以防万一。
examples.pinyin: Duō dài diǎn xiànjīn ba, yǐfángwànyī.
examples.en: Take some extra cash, just in case.

title: Marking a topic with "de hua"
structure: Topic + 的话，Comment
explanation: “的话”可标记话题，表示“说到……/至于……”，也可表示“如果……的话”。

examples.zh: 北京的话，秋天去最好。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng dehuà, qiūtiān qù zuì hǎo.
examples.en: As for Beijing, autumn is the best time to go.

examples.zh: 晚上的话，当然方便啦。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang dehuà, dāngrán fāngbiàn la.
examples.en: The evening? Of course that's convenient.

examples.zh: 这个问题的话，我不太方便说。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí dehuà, wǒ bù tài fāngbiàn shuō.
examples.en: As for this question, it's not convenient for me to talk about it.

examples.zh: 葡萄的话，一定要吃最新鲜的。
examples.pinyin: Pútao dehuà, yīdìng yào chī zuì xīnxiān de.
examples.en: For grapes, always eat the freshest ones.

title: Expressing "no matter" with "buguan"
structure: 不管 + Question Word，(Subj. +) 都……；不管 + 是 + Option A + 还是 + Option B，Subj. + 都……；不管 + [Verb/Adj.] + 不 + [Verb/Adj.]，Subj. + 都……；不管 + 多 + Adj.，Subj. + 都……
explanation: “不管……都……”表示“不管/无论……都……”。

examples.zh: 不管你穿什么，都好看。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ chuān shénme dōu hǎokàn.
examples.en: No matter what you wear, it looks good on you.

examples.zh: 不管怎么样，我们都要好好准备。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zěnmeyàng, wǒmen dōu yào hǎohāo zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: We must fully prepare no matter what.

examples.zh: 不管是国际幼儿园还是本地幼儿园，学费都很贵。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì guójì yòu'éryuán háishì běndì yòu'éryuán, xuéfèi dōu hěn guì.
examples.en: No matter if it's an international kindergarten or a local one, it's still expensive.

examples.zh: 不管多贵，我都要买。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn duō guì, wǒ dōu yào mǎi.
examples.en: No matter how expensive it is, I'm buying it.

title: Expressing "no matter" with "wulun"
structure: 无论 + Circumstances + 都/也 + Inevitable Result
explanation: “无论……都/也……”表示“无论……都……”，比“不管”正式；后半常含疑问词。

examples.zh: 无论多么成功，他总觉得自己不够好。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn duōme chénggōng, tā zǒng juéde zìjǐ bù gòu hǎo.
examples.en: No matter how successful he is, he always thinks he isn't enough.

examples.zh: 无论你到哪儿，我都会跟着你。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ dào nǎr wǒ dōu huì gēnzhe nǐ.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I will follow you.

examples.zh: 无论你说还是不说，结果都一样。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ shuō háishì bù shuō, jiéguǒ dōu yīyàng.
examples.en: Whether you speak up or not, the result will be the same.

examples.zh: 无论你做什么，我都不喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ zuò shénme, wǒ dōu bù xǐhuan.
examples.en: No matter what you do, I don't like it.

title: Advanced uses of "ba"
structure: Subj. + 把 + Obj. + 给 + Verb Phrase；把 + Obj. + 当成/看成/当作/看作 + ……；把 + Obj. + 当回事；把 + Obj. 1 + Verb + 成 + Obj. 2
explanation: “把”字句进阶：加“给”强调；表示“把……当作/看成……”；“当回事”表示重视；“把A V成B”表示变成/误认。

examples.zh: 我把这事儿给忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè shìr gěi wàng le.
examples.en: I forgot about this matter.

examples.zh: 我一直把他看作我哥哥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí bǎ tā kànzuò wǒ gēge.
examples.en: I have always seen him as my older brother.

examples.zh: 他从来不把老板的话当回事。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù bǎ lǎobǎn de huà dāng huíshì.
examples.en: He never takes what his boss says seriously.

examples.zh: 请你把这个蛋糕切成六块。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhège dàngāo qiē chéng liù kuài.
examples.en: Please cut the cake into six parts.

title: Advanced uses of "lian"
structure: 连 + Verb + 都 + 不/没 + Verb（，就……）；连 + 一 + Measure Word (+ Noun) + 都 + 不/没 + Verb
explanation: “连V都不V”表示“连……都不……”；“连一+量词+都……”表示“连一个……都没有”。

examples.zh: 朋友？这个人我连见都没见过。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou? Zhège rén wǒ lián jiàn dōu méi jiàn guo.
examples.en: Friends? I've never even met this person.

examples.zh: 你怎么连问都不问就拿别人的东西？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme lián wèn dōu bù wèn jiù ná biérén de dōngxi?
examples.en: Why are you taking other people's stuff without even asking?

examples.zh: 两年前，他连一句中文都不会说。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng nián qián, tā lián yī jù Zhōngwén dōu bù huì shuō.
examples.en: He couldn't even say a sentence in Chinese two years ago.

examples.zh: 我们连一次都没见过。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lián yī cì dōu méi jiàn guo.
examples.en: We haven't met even once.

title: Basic comparisons with "bu bi"
structure: Noun 1 + 不比 + Noun 2 + Adj.；A + 不比 + B + Verb + 得 + Adj.
explanation: “不比”是“比”的直接否定，表示“不比……更……”，不一定“不如/没有”。

examples.zh: 你并不比我聪明。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùbǐ wǒ cōngming.
examples.en: You're no smarter than I am.

examples.zh: 你并不比我差。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùbǐ wǒ chà.
examples.en: You're no worse than me.

examples.zh: 他太太的工资不比他低。
examples.pinyin: Tā tàitai de gōngzī bùbǐ tā dī.
examples.en: His wife's salary is no lower than his is.

examples.zh: 你不比歌手唱得差。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùbǐ gēshǒu chàng de chà.
examples.en: You sing no worse than the singer does.

title: Conditions with "yao" and "jiu"
structure: 要 + Verb + 就 + Verb ……
explanation: “要V就V”表示“要……就……”，语气坚决，常无主语，类似命令/建议。

examples.zh: 要走就走，我们不需要你。
examples.pinyin: Yào zǒu jiù zǒu, wǒmen bù xūyào nǐ.
examples.en: If you want to leave, leave. We don't need you.

examples.zh: 要买就买，我们快关门了。
examples.pinyin: Yào mǎi jiù mǎi, wǒmen kuài guānmén le.
examples.en: If you're going to buy it, buy it now. We are about to close the shop.

examples.zh: 要说就说，别在背后说。
examples.pinyin: Yào shuō jiù shuō, bié zài bèihòu shuō.
examples.en: If you're going to say it, say it now. Don't talk behind people's backs.

examples.zh: 要去就去，不用等我们。
examples.pinyin: Yào qù jiù qù, bùyòng děng wǒmen.
examples.en: If you want to go, go now. You don't need to wait for us.

title: Expressing "any" with "renhe"
structure: 任何 + Noun + 都/也 ……
explanation: “任何”表示“任何”，常与“都/也”搭配，一般不加“的”。

examples.zh: 你到派对以后任何饮料都不要喝。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào pàiduì yǐhòu rènhé yǐnliào dōu bùyào hē.
examples.en: After you arrive at the party, don't drink anything.

examples.zh: 这里在修路，任何车都不可以通过。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ zài xiū lù, rènhé chē dōu bù kěyǐ tōngguò.
examples.en: The road is under repair. No cars are allowed to pass here.

examples.zh: 这是我们俩的秘密，跟任何人都不要说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen liǎ de mìmì, gēn rènhé rén dōu bùyào shuō.
examples.en: This is our secret. Don't tell it to anyone.

examples.zh: 这种情况在任何时候都不能发生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng zài rènhé shíhou dōu bù néng fāshēng.
examples.en: You can't let this kind of thing happen under any circumstance.

title: Expressing "both... and..." with "ji... you"
structure: 既 + A + 又 + B；既 + [Verb Phrase]，也 + [Verb Phrase]

examples.zh: 这个同事既积极又努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tóngshì jì jījí yòu nǔlì.
examples.en: This colleague is both proactive and hard-working.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅既便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng jì piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.en: This restaurant is both cheap and delicious.

examples.zh: 这里既是你家乡，也是我家乡。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jì shì nǐ jiāxiāng, yě shì wǒ jiāxiāng.
examples.en: This is both your hometown and mine.

examples.zh: 要求是你既要会说流利的中文，也要会说流利的英文。
examples.pinyin: Yāoqiú shì nǐ jì yào huì shuō liúlì de Zhōngwén, yě yào huì shuō liúlì de Yīngwén.
examples.en: The requirement is that you need to speak both fluent Chinese and English.

title: Expressing "can't do without" with "shaobuliao"
structure: Subj. + 少不了 + Noun/Verb Phrase；Situation/Result，少不了 + 是 + Reason
explanation: “少不了”表示“少不了、不能没有”；也可表示“肯定是……”。

examples.zh: 每年春节，少不了饺子 和春晚。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián Chūnjié, shǎobuliǎo jiǎozi hé Chūnwǎn.
examples.en: Every Chinese New Year, it's gotta be dumplings and the Spring Festival Gala.

examples.zh: 如果回家晚了，少不了 一顿骂。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ huíjiā wǎn le, shǎobuliǎo yī dùn mà.
examples.en: If I get home late, there's no getting out of getting yelled at.

examples.zh: 看他的样子，少不了是跟女朋友吵架了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn tā de yàngzi, shǎobuliǎo shì gēn nǚpéngyou chǎojià le.
examples.en: Look at him. He must have argued with his girlfriend.

examples.zh: 这么闷热，少不了是要下暴雨。
examples.pinyin: Zhème mēnrè, shǎobuliǎo shì yào xià bàoyǔ.
examples.en: It's so stuffy. It must be about to storm.

title: Expressing "equal to" with "dengyu"
structure: A 等于 B
explanation: “等于”表示“等于、相当于”。

examples.zh: 今天吃了炸鸡，等于白跑步了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān chī le zhájī, děngyú bái pǎobù le.
examples.en: I ate fried chicken today, which amounts to me going jogging for nothing.

examples.zh: 你告诉小王就等于把秘密告诉了大家。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gàosù Xiǎo Wáng jiù děngyú bǎ mìmì gàosù le dàjiā.
examples.en: Telling Xiao Wang your secret is equivalent to telling everyone your secret.

examples.zh: 浪费时间等于浪费生命。
examples.pinyin: Làngfèi shíjiān děngyú làngfèi shēngmìng.
examples.en: Wasting your time is wasting your life.

examples.zh: 吃一半西瓜等于吃三碗米饭。
examples.pinyin: Chī yībàn xīguā děngyú chī sān wǎn mǐfàn.
examples.en: Eating half of a watermelon is equivalent to eating three bowls of rice.

title: Expressing "from" with "cong... zhong"
structure: 从 + Source + 中 + Result
explanation: “从……中”表示“从……中（获得/发现/学到）”。

examples.zh: 我从书中学习了很多知识。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng shū zhōng xuéxí le hěn duō zhīshi.
examples.en: I learned a lot from the book.

examples.zh: 我们从聊天中知道小王不喜欢咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng liáotiān zhōng zhīdào Xiǎo Wáng bù xǐhuan kāfēi.
examples.en: We know from chatting that Xiao Wang doesn't like coffee.

examples.zh: 从这件事中小王明白了诚实的重要。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè jiàn shì zhōng Xiǎo Wáng míngbai le chéngshí de zhòngyào.
examples.en: Xiao Wang knows the importance of honesty from this matter.

examples.zh: 从老房子中我们找出来很多九十年代的东西。
examples.pinyin: Cóng lǎo fángzi zhōng wǒmen zhǎo chūlái hěn duō jiǔshí niándài de dōngxi.
examples.en: We found a lot of stuff from the nineties in the old house.

title: Expressing indifference with "jiu"
structure: Verb + 就 + Verb；不 + Adj./Verb + 就 + 不 + Adj./Verb
explanation: “V就V”表示“无所谓、不在乎”；否定“不V就不V”表示“不……就不……”。

examples.zh: 坏了就坏了，再买新的。
examples.pinyin: Huài le jiù huài le, zài mǎi xīn de.
examples.en: If it's broken, leave it there. We can buy a new one.

examples.zh: 走就走，我早就不想干了！
examples.pinyin: Zǒu jiù zǒu, wǒ zǎojiù bù xiǎng gàn le!
examples.en: Sure, I'll leave. I wanted to quit a long time ago!

examples.zh: 反对就反对，我不在乎。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnduì jiù fǎnduì, wǒ bù zàihu.
examples.en: If they oppose it, let them oppose it. I don't care.

examples.zh: 她 不 高兴 就 不 高兴 ，不 是 我 的 错 。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù gāoxìng jiù bù gāoxìng, bù shì wǒ de cuò.
examples.en: If she's unhappy, she's unhappy. It's not like it's my fault.

title: Expressing "no (noun) to (verb)" with "wu... ke..."
structure: 无 + Noun + 可 + Verb
explanation: “无……可……”表示“没有……可以……”，较书面。

examples.zh: 我和他无话可说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā wú huà kě shuō.
examples.en: I had nothing to say to him.

examples.zh: 公司倒闭了，小王觉得自己现在无路可走。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī dǎobì le, Xiǎo Wáng juéde zìjǐ xiànzài wú lù kě zǒu.
examples.en: The company has gone bankrupt, and Xiao Wang feels that he has nowhere to go.

examples.zh: 公司需要招聘新人了，我现在无人可用。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào zhāopìn xīnrén le, wǒ xiànzài wú rén kě yòng.
examples.en: The company needs to recruit new people. I have no one to help me now.

examples.zh: 从四月份开始，公司客户减少，我每天都无事可做。
examples.pinyin: Cóng sìyuèfèn kāishǐ, gōngsī kèhù jiǎnshǎo, wǒ měitiān dōu wú shì kě zuò.
examples.en: Since April, the company has fewer clients, so I have nothing to do every day.

title: Expressing "not even one"
structure: 一 + Measure Word + Noun + [也/都] + [不/没] + Verb；Topic + Subj. + 一 + Measure Word + Noun + [也/都] + Verb
explanation: “一+量词+名词+也/都不/没+动词”表示“连一个……都没有”。

examples.zh: 他一句话都没说。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī jù huà dōu méi shuō.
examples.en: He didn't say a thing.

examples.zh: 他一句中文都不会说。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī jù Zhōngwén dōu bù huì shuō.
examples.en: He can't speak one sentence of Chinese.

examples.zh: 为什么这里一个人都没有？
examples.pinyin: Wèishénme zhèlǐ yī gè rén dōu méiyǒu?
examples.en: Why is there not a single person here?

examples.zh: 我一口都没吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī kǒu dōu méi chī.
examples.en: I haven't had a single bite.

similar: Expressing "not at all" with "yidianr ye bu"

title: Expressing "not only..., even..." using "budan..., shenzhi lian"
structure: Subj. + 不但……，甚至连 + New Subject + 也 + Matching Situation
explanation: “不但……甚至连……也……”表示“不但……甚至连……也……”。

examples.zh: 他不但不知道李连杰，甚至连成龙也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùdàn bù zhīdào Lǐ Liánjié, shènzhì lián Chéng Lóng yě bù zhīdào.
examples.en: Not only does he not know Jet Li, he doesn't even know Jackie Chan.

examples.zh: 妹妹不但喜欢榴莲这样味道重的，甚至连臭豆腐也喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei bùdàn xǐhuan liúlián zhèyàng wèidào zhòng de, shènzhì lián chòu dòufu yě xǐhuan.
examples.en: My sister not only likes durian, which has a strong flavor, but even stinky tofu too.

examples.zh: 你男朋友不但帮你做好了攻略，甚至连飞机票也帮你买好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nánpéngyou bùdàn bāng nǐ zuò hǎo le gōnglüè, shènzhì lián fēijīpiào yě bāng nǐ mǎi hǎo le.
examples.en: Your boyfriend not only helped you with your vacation planning, he even helped you buy your plane tickets.

examples.zh: 在家里隔离的时候，不但小区出不去，甚至连家门也不让你出去。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiālǐ gélí de shíhou, bùdàn xiǎoqū chū bu qù, shènzhì lián jiāmén yě bù ràng nǐ chūqù.
examples.en: When isolating at home, you can't leave your neighborhood, and you aren't even allowed to leave your house.

similar: Expressing "not only... but also" with "budan... erqie..."
Many types of "not only... but also..."

title: Expressing purpose with "hao"
structure: Action，好 + Purpose
explanation: “好 + 动词短语”表示“以便、为了”。

examples.zh: 她睡前常常喝牛奶，好入睡。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuì qián chángcháng hē niúnǎi, hǎo rùshuì.
examples.en: She often drinks milk before bedtime to help her fall asleep.

examples.zh: 老师，请说慢点儿，我们好做笔记。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, qǐng shuō màn diǎnr, wǒmen hǎo zuò bǐjì.
examples.en: Teacher, you need to speak a little slower so that we can take notes.

examples.zh: 请把车停到里面，好让别人走路。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chē tíng dào lǐmiàn, hǎo ràng biérén zǒulù.
examples.en: Please park the car inside so that other people can walk here.

examples.zh: 他学习非常努力，好考个好大学。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuéxí fēicháng nǔlì, hǎo kǎo gè hǎo dàxué.
examples.en: He is studying very hard so that he can get into a good university.

similar: Using "lai" to connect two verb phrases

title: Expressing "related to..." with "you guan de"
structure: 跟/和 + Topic + 有关的 + Noun；与 + Topic + 有关的 + Noun
explanation: “跟/和……有关的”口语；“与……有关的”正式。否定“与……无关的”。

examples.zh: 我和他分手了，跟他有关的事情我都不想知道。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā fēnshǒu le, gēn tā yǒuguān de shìqing wǒ dōu bù xiǎng zhīdào.
examples.en: We broke up, I don't want to know anything related to him.

examples.zh: 他对中国很感兴趣，跟中国有关的故事他都很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Zhōngguó hěn gǎn xìngqù, gēn Zhōngguó yǒuguān de gùshi tā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: He is very interested in China, he is interested in anything related to Chinese history.

examples.zh: 与游戏有关的活动，我都想参加。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yóuxì yǒuguān de huódòng, wǒ dōu xiǎng cānjiā.
examples.en: I would like to participate in any activity related to the game.

examples.zh: 与疫苗有关的研究已经开始了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yìmiáo yǒuguān de yánjiū yǐjīng kāishǐ le.
examples.en: Research on the vaccine has already begun.

title: Expressing simultaneous actions with "yimian"
structure: 一面 + Verb + 一面 + Verb
explanation: “一面……一面……”表示“一边……一边……”，比“一边”正式。

examples.zh: 我一面哭一面跑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīmiàn kū yīmiàn pǎo.
examples.en: I cried while running away.

examples.zh: 他喜欢一面吃东西，一面看电影。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yīmiàn chī dōngxi, yīmiàn kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: He likes to eat and watch movies at the same time.

examples.zh: 他们一家人一面赏月一面吃月饼。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yījiārén yīmiàn shǎngyuè yīmiàn chī yuèbǐng.
examples.en: They enjoy the full moon and eat moon cakes together as a family.

examples.zh: 为了赚钱，哥哥一面读书一面做兼职。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhuànqián, gēge yīmiàn dúshū yīmiàn zuò jiānzhí.
examples.en: To earn money, my big brother is studying and working part-time at the same time.

title: Expressing "so-called" with "suowei"
structure: 所谓 + (的) Noun Phrase
explanation: “所谓”表示“所谓”，可带质疑/讽刺，也可中性。

examples.zh: 所谓的天才，有可能有这样的人，也有可能，他自己偷偷地努力。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi de tiāncái, yǒu kěnéng yǒu zhèyàng de rén, yě yǒu kěnéng, tā zìjǐ tōutōu de nǔlì.
examples.en: There may be such a person as this so-called "genius," or, possibly, he has been secretly trying really hard.

examples.zh: 没有所谓的失败，除非你不想再尝试。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu suǒwèi de shībài, chúfēi nǐ bù xiǎng zài chángshì.
examples.en: There is no such thing as so-called "failure," unless you do not want to try again.

examples.zh: 所谓的“名医”，连最基本的医学知识都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi de "míngyī", lián zuì jīběn de yīxué zhīshì dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.en: So-called "famous doctors" do not even know the most basic medical knowledge.

examples.zh: 所谓企业管理，是需要解决一个接一个的问题。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi qǐyè guǎnlǐ, shì xūyào jiějué yī gè jiē yī gè de wèntí.
examples.en: So-called "corporate management" requires solving one problem after another.

title: Expressing "the more... the more..." with "yue... yue..."
structure: Subj. + 越……，越……；Subj. 1 + 越……，Subj. 2 + 越……；越……越 + 不……；Subj. + 越 + Verb + 越 + 想 + Verb

examples.zh: 我们越想越生气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuè xiǎng yuè shēngqì.
examples.en: The more we think about it, the angrier we get.

examples.zh: 他越跑越快。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuè pǎo yuè kuài.
examples.en: He ran faster and faster.

examples.zh: 她越说，我越生气。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuè shuō, wǒ yuè shēngqì.
examples.en: The more she talks, the angrier I get.

examples.zh: 你越让孩子学，孩子越不想学。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuè ràng háizi xué, háizi yuè bù xiǎng xué.
examples.en: The more you push the kid to study, the less he wants to study.

title: Expressing the only two possibilities
structure: 不是 + A，就是 + B
explanation: “不是A就是B”表示“不是A就是B”，只有两种可能。

examples.zh: 他整天不是打游戏就是睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhěngtiān bù shì dǎ yóuxì jiùshì shuìjiào.
examples.en: If he's not playing video games all day, he's sleeping.

examples.zh: 他们约会不是去咖啡馆就是去电影院。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yuēhuì bù shì qù kāfēiguǎn jiùshì qù diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.en: When they go on dates, if it's not to a coffee shop, then it's to the movie theater.

examples.zh: 我买的衣服不是大就是小，都不能穿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de yīfu bù shì dà jiùshì xiǎo, dōu bù néng chuān.
examples.en: The clothes that I bought are always either too big or too small. I can't wear any of them.

examples.zh: 不是你 就是他干的，别人一点都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Bù shì nǐ jiùshì tā gàn de, biérén yīdiǎn dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.en: Either you did it or he did it. No one else knows anything about it.

title: Expressing "within" a period of time using "zai... nei"
structure: 在 + (a period of time) + 内
explanation: “在……内”表示“在……之内”。

examples.zh: 在短短的两年内，他就成为了CEO。
examples.pinyin: Zài duǎnduǎn de liǎng nián nèi, tā jiù chéngwéi le CEO.
examples.en: In just two years, he has become the CEO.

examples.zh: 政府计划在十年内研究出电动汽车。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài shí nián nèi yánjiū chū diàndòng qìchē.
examples.en: The government plans to develop an electric car within ten years.

examples.zh: 在未来两个月内，这款游戏会上市。
examples.pinyin: Zài wèilái liǎng gè yuè nèi, zhè kuǎn yóuxì huì shàngshì.
examples.en: In the next two months, this game will be on the market.

examples.zh: 在未来三年内，我希望能考过HSK5。
examples.pinyin: Zài wèilái sān nián nèi, wǒ xīwàng néng kǎo guò HSK wǔ.
examples.en: In the next three years, I hope to pass HSK 5.

title: Expressing "would rather" with "ningke"
structure: 宁可……，也不……；宁可……，也要……
explanation: “宁可……也不……”表示“宁可……也不……”；“宁可……也要……”表示“宁可……也要……”。

examples.zh: 我宁可没有男朋友，也不要随便找一个男朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nìngkě méiyǒu nánpéngyou, yě bù yào suíbiàn zhǎo yī gè nánpéngyou.
examples.en: I'd rather have no boyfriend than find a random one.

examples.zh: 我们宁可早到也不要迟到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen nìngkě zǎo dào yě bù yào chídào.
examples.en: We'd rather arrive early than late.

examples.zh: 我宁可熬夜也要做完。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nìngkě áoyè yě yào zuò wán.
examples.en: I'd rather stay up tonight just to finish it.

examples.zh: 孩子们宁可不吃饭，也要多玩一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen nìngkě bù chīfàn, yě yào duō wán yīhuǐr.
examples.en: The kids would rather not eat just to play a little longer.

title: Providing two options with double "huozhe"
structure: 或者 A，或者 B
explanation: “或者A，或者B”表示“或者A，或者B”，给出两个选项。

examples.zh: 只有一块蛋糕，或者你吃或者我吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yīkuài dàngāo, huòzhě nǐ chī huòzhě wǒ chī.
examples.en: There's only one piece of cake. Either you eat it, or I eat it.

examples.zh: 你或者学汉语，或者学法律，别的就别学了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huòzhě xué Hànyǔ, huòzhě xué fǎlǜ, bié de jiù bié xué le.
examples.en: Either study Chinese or law. Don't study anything else.

examples.zh: 咱们或者去爬山或者泡温泉。
examples.pinyin: Zánmen huòzhě qù páshān huòzhě pào wēnquán.
examples.en: Let's either go hiking or go for a soak in the hot springs.

examples.zh: 咱们或者今天去或者明天去，一定要去。
examples.pinyin: Zánmen huòzhě jīntiān qù huòzhě míngtiān qù, yīdìng yào qù.
examples.en: We can either go today or tomorrow, but we must go.

title: Expressing "let alone" with "bie shuo"
structure: 别说 + A，连/就是 + B + 也/都 + Verb
explanation: “别说A，连/就是B也/都……”表示“别说A，连B都……”。

examples.zh: 别说一百，就是一块钱我也不给你。
examples.pinyin: Bié shuō yībǎi, jiùshì yīkuài qián wǒ yě bù gěi nǐ.
examples.en: Don't think about one hundred, I won't even give you one kuai.

examples.zh: 别说白酒，连啤酒的味道我都受不了。
examples.pinyin: Bié shuō báijiǔ, lián píjiǔ de wèidào wǒ dōu shòubuliǎo.
examples.en: Don't even mention baijiu; I can't even stand the taste of beer.

examples.zh: 别说英语，你说中文我也不知道怎么回答。
examples.pinyin: Bié shuō Yīngyǔ, nǐ shuō Zhōngwén wǒ yě bù zhīdào zěnme huídá.
examples.en: Forget about English! Even if you speak Chinese, I don't know how to answer.

examples.zh: 这么难的问题，别说你，就是老师也不知道答案。
examples.pinyin: Zhème nán de wèntí, bié shuō nǐ, jiùshì lǎoshī yě bù zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: Such a hard question! Even the teacher doesn't know the answer, let alone you.

title: Expressing "let alone" with "geng buyong shuo"
structure: 连 + A + 都/也 + Verb，更不用说 + B + 了
explanation: “连A都/也……，更不用说B了”表示“连A都……，更不用说B了”。

examples.zh: 连我都不知道这个歌手，更不用说他了。
examples.pinyin: Lián wǒ dōu bù zhīdào zhège gēshǒu, gèng bùyòng shuō tā le.
examples.en: I don't even know the singer, let alone him.

examples.zh: 连家人都不理解你，更不用说其他的人了。
examples.pinyin: Lián jiārén dōu bù lǐjiě nǐ, gèng bùyòng shuō qítā de rén le.
examples.en: Even your family doesn't understand you, let alone other people.

examples.zh: 连周末都要加班，更不用说工作日了。
examples.pinyin: Lián zhōumò dōu yào jiābān, gèng bùyòng shuō gōngzuòrì le.
examples.en: I have to work overtime even on weekends, not to mention work days.

examples.zh: 这里连我都住不下去，更不用说你了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ lián wǒ dōu zhù bù xiàqù, gèng bùyòng shuō nǐ le.
examples.en: I can't even keep living here, let alone you.

title: Many types of "not only... but also..."
structure: Subj. + 不仅/不但/不只 + ……，而且/还/也 + ……
explanation: “不仅/不但/不只……而且/还/也……”表示“不仅……而且/还/也……”。

examples.zh: 我不只对排球感兴趣，而且对足球也很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bùzhǐ duì páiqiú gǎnxìngqù, érqiě duì zúqiú yě hěn gǎnxìngqù.
examples.en: I am not only interested in volleyball, but also in soccer.

examples.zh: 王师傅不但会开车，还会修车。
examples.pinyin: Wáng Shīfu bùdàn huì kāichē, hái huì xiū chē.
examples.en: Not only does Master Wang drive a car, he also repairs cars.

examples.zh: 他不仅懒，还馋。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn lǎn, hái chán.
examples.en: He is not only lazy, but also greedy.

examples.zh: 这家超市不仅种类多，价格也不贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì bùjǐn zhǒnglèi duō, jiàgé yě bù guì.
examples.en: This supermarket not only has a wide variety of products, but also low prices.

similar: Expressing "not only... but also" with "budan... erqie..."
Using "budan... geng" to express "not only... but also"
Expressing "not only..., even..." using "budan..., shenzhi lian"

title: Comparing "benlai" and "yuanlai"
structure: 本来 + 是……的，但是/可是……；本来 + 就……；原来 + 是……；原来 + 的 + Noun
explanation: “本来”表示“原本、本来”（计划变化/强调）；“原来”表示“原来、从前/原来是……”。

examples.zh: 我本来是要去参加你的生日派对的，可是周末突然要加班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái shì yào qù cānjiā nǐ de shēngrì pàiduì de, kěshì zhōumò tūrán yào jiābān.
examples.en: I was originally going to go to your birthday party, but I had to work some extra time this weekend.

examples.zh: 生活本来就很不容易。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó běnlái jiù hěn bù róngyì.
examples.en: Life isn't supposed to be very easy.

examples.zh: 原来是你啊！我刚才真没看出来。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì nǐ a! Wǒ gāngcái zhēn méi kàn chūlái.
examples.en: It was you all along! I didn't recognize you until just now.

examples.zh: 这是我原来的家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ yuánlái de jiā.
examples.en: This is my old house.

title: Comparing "cai" and "jiu"
structure: Subj. + Time Word + 才 + Verb；Subj. + Time + 就 + Verb + 了；才/就 + (Verb) + Measure Word + Noun；Subj. + 才 + Verb + 就 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “才”常表晚/少/不易；“就”常表早/快/少；两者可同用“才V就V”。

examples.zh: 我等了两个小时才买到票。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái mǎi dào piào.
examples.en: I waited two hours before I could buy the ticket.

examples.zh: 我们这么多人，你才点了三个菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu zhème duō rén, nǐ cái diǎn le sān gè cài.
examples.en: We have so many people and you only ordered three dishes.

examples.zh: 她十九岁就结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shíjiǔ suì jiù jiéhūn le.
examples.en: She got married when she was only 19.

examples.zh: 他才毕业就找到了这么好的工作？
examples.pinyin: Tā cái bìyè jiù zhǎodào le zhème hǎo de gōngzuò?
examples.en: He just graduated and already found such a good job?

title: Comparing "zai" and "you"
structure: Subj. + 再 + Verb（将来）；Subj. + 又 + Verb + 了（过去）；Subj. + (先) + Action 1 + 再 + Action 2；Subj. + 又 + (Aux.) + Verb + Obj.
explanation: “再”用于将来重复/另一个/然后；“又”用于过去重复/将来情绪色彩。

examples.zh: 我们下次再来吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàcì zài lái ba.
examples.en: We will come here again next time.

examples.zh: 我想再看一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài kàn yīxià.
examples.en: I want to take another look.

examples.zh: 你怎么又给我打电话了，什么事？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yòu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le, shénme shì?
examples.en: Why do you keep calling me? What is it?

examples.zh: 明天又是星期一！
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yòu shì Xīngqīyī!
examples.en: Tomorrow is Monday again.

similar: Repeated actions in the past with "you"

title: Comparing "zongsuan" and "zhongyu"
structure: Subj. + 总算/终于 + Verb
explanation: “总算”较口语，带不耐烦/抱怨；“终于”较正式、客观。

examples.zh: 你总算来了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒngsuàn lái le!
examples.en: You finally came!

examples.zh: 我终于懂了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú dǒng le.
examples.en: I finally understood it.

examples.zh: 谢天谢地，你总算来了。
examples.pinyin: Xiè tiān xiè dì, nǐ zǒngsuàn lái le.
examples.en: Thank God, you finally came.

examples.zh: 你终于决定了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhōngyú juédìng le!
examples.en: You finally decided!

title: Comparing "gen" and "dui"
structure: Person A + 跟/对 + Person B 说；A + 跟 + B + (不)一样 (+ Adj.)；Subj. + 对 + Person + Verb
explanation: “跟/对”都可与“说”搭配；“跟”可表比较/和；“对”表朝向/对象。

examples.zh: 我跟她说了，但是她不 信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā shuō le, dànshì tā bù xìn.
examples.en: I told her, but she didn't believe me.

examples.zh: 我跟你们不一样，我还有孩子呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nǐmen bù yīyàng, wǒ hái yǒu háizi ne.
examples.en: I am not like you guys. I still have kids.

examples.zh: 上海跟纽约一样，都是国际大都市。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi gēn Niǔyuē yīyàng, dōu shì guójì dà dūshì.
examples.en: Shanghai and New York are alike; they are both international cities.

examples.zh: 那个美女正对我笑呢。
examples.pinyin: Nàge měinǚ zhèng duì wǒ xiào ne.
examples.en: That pretty girl is laughing at me.

title: Comparing "chao" "xiang" and "wang"
structure: 向/朝/往 + Direction + Verb；Verb + 向/往 + Direction；向/朝 + Target + Concrete Verb；向 + Target + Abstract Verb
explanation: 三者都可表方向；动词后多用“向/往”；具体目标用“向/朝”；抽象目标只用“向”。

examples.zh: 从这里向/朝/往北走两百米就到了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ xiàng/cháo/wǎng běi zǒu liǎngbǎi mǐ jiù dào le.
examples.en: From here, go one hundred meters north, and you'll get there.

examples.zh: 这趟火车开往沈阳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tàng huǒchē kāiwǎng Shěnyáng.
examples.en: This train is heading towards Shenyang.

examples.zh: 他向我笑了笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ xiào le xiào.
examples.en: He chuckled at me.

examples.zh: 他是优秀员工，我们都要向他学习。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yōuxiù yuángōng, wǒmen dōu yào xiàng tā xuéxí.
examples.en: He is an exemplary employee, we should all learn from him.

title: Comparing "dui" and "duiyu"
structure: 对/对于 + Object + Verb；Subj. + 对 + B + Adj.；Subj. + 对着/对上/对不上
explanation: 作介词时“对/对于”多可互换；“对于”不能位于句中副词后；“对”还可作动词/与情绪形容词搭配。

examples.zh: 对(于)这种事情，你有什么看法？
examples.pinyin: Duì(yú) zhè zhǒng shìqing, nǐ yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
examples.en: As for this kind of thing, what's your perspective?

examples.zh: 我们都对这个问题很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu duì zhège wèntí hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: We are all interested in this problem.

examples.zh: 枪口不要对着人。
examples.pinyin: Qiāngkǒu bùyào duìzhe rén.
examples.en: Don't point the gun at people.

examples.zh: 他对工作很认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò hěn rènzhēn.
examples.en: He treats his work very seriously.

title: Comparing "duiyu" and "zhiyu"
structure: Subj. + 对于 + Object + Predicate；对于 + Object，Subj. + Predicate；至于 + Topic，Subj. + Verb Phrase；（不）至于 + Degree
explanation: “对于”强调对象；“至于”用于转换话题或强调程度。

examples.zh: 对于电脑，我什么都不懂。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú diànnǎo, wǒ shénme dōu bù dǒng.
examples.en: With regards to computers, I don't understand anything.

examples.zh: 我们要开始这个项目了，至于什么时候开始，还没定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào kāishǐ zhège xiàngmù le, zhìyú shénme shíhou kāishǐ, hái méi dìng.
examples.en: We're going to start this project, but as for when to start, we still haven't decided.

examples.zh: 这点小事情，至于这么生气吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shìqing, zhìyú zhème shēngqì ma?
examples.en: Over such a small thing, why are you so angry?

examples.zh: 我是不高兴，但不至于不跟你说话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì bù gāoxìng, dàn bù zhìyú bù gēn nǐ shuōhuà.
examples.en: I'm not happy, but not to the point that I won't talk with you.

title: Comparing "gei" and "wei"
structure: Subj. + 给 + Recipient + [Verb Phrase]；为 + Person + Verb/Adj.
explanation: “给”偏善意/具体帮助；“为”偏正式/责任/情绪反应。

examples.zh: 请给我拿一双筷子。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ ná yī shuāng kuàizi.
examples.en: Please get me a pair of chopsticks.

examples.zh: 这件事是你做得不对，给他道歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì nǐ zuò de bù duì, gěi tā dàoqiàn.
examples.en: What you did was wrong. Apologize to him.

examples.zh: 我现在为谷歌公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài wèi Gǔgē gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.en: I currently work for Google.

examples.zh: 我真的为你高兴。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēnde wèi nǐ gāoxìng.
examples.en: I'm truly happy for you.

title: Comparing "guanyu" and "duiyu"
structure: 关于 + Topic，Comment；对于 + Object，Comment
explanation: “关于”引出话题/范围；“对于”引出对象并常带态度/结论。

examples.zh: 对于那个人我并不了解。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú nàge rén wǒ bìng bù liǎojiě.
examples.en: As for that person, I just don't know him very well at all.

examples.zh: 对于我们的工作表现，老板很满意。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú wǒmen de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì.
examples.en: The boss is very satisfied with our work performance.

examples.zh: 他昨天发表了一个关于中国经济的演讲。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān fābiǎo le yī gè guānyú Zhōngguó jīngjì de yǎnjiǎng.
examples.en: Yesterday he made a speech about the Chinese economy.

examples.zh: 关于你辞职的申请，公司还在考虑。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú nǐ cízhí de shēnqǐng, gōngsī hái zài kǎolǜ.
examples.en: With regards to your application for resignation, the company is still considering it.

title: Comparing "shihe" and "heshi"
structure: Subj. + 适合 + Obj.；Subj. + Adv. + 合适
explanation: “适合”是动词，后接宾语；“合适”是形容词。

examples.zh: 这个工作很适合我。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò hěn shìhé wǒ.
examples.en: This job really suits me.

examples.zh: 你的中文名字真适合你！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de Zhōngwén míngzi zhēn shìhé nǐ!
examples.en: Your Chinese name suits you well.

examples.zh: 在办公室里抽烟有点不合适吧。
examples.pinyin: Zài bàngōngshì lǐ chōuyān yǒudiǎn bù héshì ba.
examples.en: Inside the office, it's not really appropriate to smoke, right?

examples.zh: 他就是最合适的，他完全符合我们的招聘要求。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiùshì zuì héshì de, tā wánquán fúhé wǒmen de zhāopìn yāoqiú.
examples.en: He is just the most suitable. He totally fulfills our hiring requirements.

title: Comparing "pingshi" and "pingchang"
structure: Subj. + 平常/平时 + Verb；Subj. + 很 + 平常；平常 + 的 + Noun
explanation: 作副词时可互换；“平常”还可作形容词“普通/平常”。

examples.zh: 你平常会健身吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng huì jiànshēn ma?
examples.en: Do you often work out?

examples.zh: 我平常不吃零食。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng bù chī língshí.
examples.en: I usually don't eat snacks.

examples.zh: 清洁工的工作很平常，但是也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Qīngjiégōng de gōngzuò hěn píngcháng, dànshì yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: The work of sanitary workers is very ordinary, but it is also very important.

examples.zh: 对中国来说，2008年是很不平常的一年。
examples.pinyin: Duì Zhōngguó lái shuō, èr-líng-líng-bā nián shì hěn bù píngcháng de yī nián.
examples.en: For China, 2008 was not an ordinary year.

title: Comparing "yihou" and "zhihou"
structure: Subj. + Specified Time + 以后/之后 + Verb；以后，……；(Event 1，) 之后 + Event 2
explanation: 两者都可表“之后”；“以后”单独用表“将来”；“之后”单独用表“那之后”。

examples.zh: 下过雨以后空气会好很多。
examples.pinyin: Xià guo yǔ yǐhòu kōngqì huì hǎo hěn duō.
examples.en: After it rains, the air will be a lot better.

examples.zh: 结婚之后他们有了两个宝宝。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīhòu tāmen yǒu le liǎng gè bǎobao.
examples.en: After getting married, they had two babies.

examples.zh: 以后 我 可能 会 去 国外 上 大学 。
examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ kěnéng huì qù guówài shàng dàxué.
examples.en: In the future I might go to college abroad.

examples.zh: 我 要 先 回家 把 东西 放 下 ，之后 去 咖啡店 找 你 。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiān huí jiā bǎ dōngxi fàng xià, zhīhòu qù kāfēidiàn zhǎo nǐ.
examples.en: I'm going to go home and drop my stuff off first, after that go to the cafe to look for you.

similar: In the future in general with "yihou"

title: Comparing "yihou" "ranhou" "houlai"
structure: 然后：先……，然后……；以后：以后，…… / Time + 以后；后来：[Past Event 1]，后来 + [Past Event 2]
explanation: “然后”表“然后”；“以后”表“将来/之后”；“后来”表“后来（过去）”。

examples.zh: 我们先复习一下，然后上新课。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān fùxí yīxià, ránhòu shàng xīn kè.
examples.en: Let's do some review first and then study a new lesson.

examples.zh: 我以后想开公司。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐhòu xiǎng kāi gōngsī.
examples.en: I want to start up my own business in the future.

examples.zh: 毕业以后他出国了。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè yǐhòu tā chūguó le.
examples.en: He went abroad after he graduated.

examples.zh: 他在我们公司干过两年，后来跳槽了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǒmen gōngsī gàn guo liǎng nián, hòulái tiàocáo le.
examples.en: He worked for our company for two years, and then he jumped ship.

similar: In the future in general with "yihou"

title: Comparing "kanqilai" and "kanlai"
structure: Subj. + 看起来 + Adj.；Subj. + 看起来 + 像 + ……；看来 + Perspective；在 + Person + 看来 + Perspective
explanation: “看起来”表外观/看起来像；“看来”表对情况的判断/看法。

examples.zh: 女儿今天看起来很开心。
examples.pinyin: Nǚ'ér jīntiān kànqǐlái hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: Our daughter looks really happy today.

examples.zh: 你姐姐真漂亮！看起来像明星。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhēn piàoliang! Kànqǐlái xiàng míngxīng.
examples.en: Your big sister is so pretty! She looks like a celebrity.

examples.zh: 雨这么大，看来他不来了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ zhème dà, kànlái tā bù lái le.
examples.en: It's raining so hard. It seems he's not coming.

examples.zh: 在我看来，最好的办法是大家一起合作。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, zuìhǎo de bànfǎ shì dàjiā yīqǐ hézuò.
examples.en: The way I see it, the best solution is for everyone to cooperate.

title: Comparing "xiande" and "kanqilai"
structure: A + 显得 + B + Predicate；Subj. + 看起来 + Predicate
explanation: “显得”偏客观描述/比较；“看起来”偏主观观察。

examples.zh: 这样穿显得我比较成熟。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng chuān xiǎnde wǒ bǐjiào chéngshú.
examples.en: Dressing like this makes me appear more mature.

examples.zh: 那样吃显得你很没礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Nàyàng chī xiǎnde nǐ hěn méi lǐmào.
examples.en: Eating like that makes you look very impolite.

examples.zh: 你今天看起来很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān kànqǐlái hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: You seem very happy today.

examples.zh: 这个餐厅看起来不错，我们可以试试。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cāntīng kànqǐlái bùcuò, wǒmen kěyǐ shìshi.
examples.en: This restaurant seems pretty good. Let's try it out.
